https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/angl.body: NNEWI — The Church of Nigeria (Anglican Communion), Province of the Niger, has warned the Presidency, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) against manipulating the 2027 general elections or taking Nigerians for granted. The church also cautioned against moves towards a one-party system, describing the alleged intimidation of opposition parties and their candidates as dangerous to the country’s democracy. It urged Nigerians not to approach the 2027 presidential and other elections with indifference but to use their votes to hold political leaders accountable for unfulfilled promises. The Coordinating Bishop of the Province of the Niger, Bishop of Aguata and Supervising Bishop of the Diocese of Awka, Rt. Rev. Dr Samuel C. Ezeofor, gave the warning during the 2026 Anglican Prayer Rally of Anambra State (APRAS). Ezeofor recalled that the province had, during its synod in May, warned Nigerians about the dangers of a one-party system and urged citizens to remain vigilant. Addressing the Presidency, INEC, the APC and other political stakeholders, the bishop said Nigerians were increasingly dissatisfied with developments in the country and should not be taken for granted. “If they take Nigerians for granted, it may come to a point where there may be a revolution. I don’t pray for that, but by my training, I am trained to believe the best but be prepared for the worst,” he said. He urged those involved in the 2027 electoral process to respect the wishes of voters and ensure that the outcome reflected their choices. “So both the Presidency, APC, INEC and all the people who are involved in the election that is coming in 2027, let everyone of them be careful and do what Nigerians said with their ballots and would want to be done with their votes,” he added. On the internal challenges facing the Province of the Niger, Ezeofor acknowledged that some Anglican faithful might have become discouraged by the crisis within the church. He, however, urged them to remain steadfast, saying that setbacks in the church’s human administration did not mean God had abandoned it. “My message to our faithfuls is that as human beings, we may stumble, but God is still on his throne. This church belongs to God, yet it is human beings who run the church and it is also a human system,” he said. He encouraged members to continue looking up to Jesus Christ, whom he described as the author and finisher of their faith, expressing optimism that the situation would improve. The 2026 prayer rally, themed “Dwelling in the Secret Place of the Most High God”, was attended by six bishops of the province, including the retired Archbishop of the Province of the Niger, Most Rev. Prof. Godwin Okpara. Others in attendance were Bishop Ephraim Ikeako of the Diocese of Amichi, Bishop Prosper Amah of the Diocese of Ogbaru, Bishop Ndubuisi Obi of the Diocese of Nnewi and Bishop Obiora Uzochukwu of the Diocese of Niger East. Earlier, the preacher at the rally, Venerable Dr Emma Ezeugo, urged Christians to devote more time to prayer and fasting, particularly as December approaches. He said prayer brought peace, protection and peace of mind, urging believers to seek God’s presence in their daily lives. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/angl.title_zh: 圣公会警告蒂努布和独立国家选举委员会不得操纵2027年选举
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/angl.body_zh: 恩内韦——尼日利亚教会（圣公会共融体）尼日尔教省已警告总统府、独立国家选举委员会（INEC）和执政的进步大Congress（APC），不得操纵2027年大选，也不得把尼日利亚人当作理所当然。该教会还警告不要推动一党制，并称据称对反对党及其候选人的恐吓行为危害国家民主。教会敦促尼日利亚人不应对2027年总统选举及其他选举持冷漠态度，而应利用选票追究政治领导人未兑现承诺的责任。尼日尔教省协调主教、阿古阿塔主教兼阿瓦卡教区监督主教塞缪尔·C·埃泽福尔博士阁下，在2026年阿南布拉州圣公会祈祷集会（APRAS）期间发出这一警告。埃泽福尔回顾称，该教省曾在5月举行的教区会议上警告尼日利亚人注意一党制的危险，并敦促公民保持警惕。主教向总统府、INEC、APC及其他政治利益相关者发表讲话时表示，尼日利亚人对国家 developments 越来越不满，不应被当作理所当然。他说：“如果他们把尼日利亚人当作理所当然，可能最终会爆发革命。我不祈祷这种事发生，但凭我的训练，我被教导要相信最好的结果，同时也要为最坏的情况做好准备。”他敦促参与2027年选举进程的人士尊重选民的意愿，确保选举结果反映选民的选择。他补充道：“所以，无论是总统府、APC、INEC，还是所有参与2027年即将举行的选举的人，每个人都要谨慎行事，遵照尼日利亚人用选票表达的要求，以及他们希望用选票实现的事情。”谈及尼日尔教省内部面临的问题，埃泽福尔承认，一些圣公会信徒可能因教会内部危机而感到气馁，但他敦促他们坚定不移，表示教会在人事管理方面遭遇挫折并不意味着上帝已经抛弃了教会。他说：“我给信徒的信息是，作为人类，我们可能会跌倒，但上帝仍然坐在祂的宝座上。这教会属于上帝，但由人来管理，也是一套由人运作的制度。”他鼓励会众继续仰望耶稣基督，并称耶稣基督是他们信仰的创始者和成全者，同时对局势改善表示乐观。2026年祈祷集会的主题是“住在至高上帝的隐秘处”，教省的六位主教出席了活动，其中包括尼日尔教省退休大主教戈德温·奥克帕教授阁下。出席者还包括阿米奇教区以弗莱姆·伊克亚科主教、奥格巴鲁教区普罗斯佩尔·阿马主教、恩韦伊教区恩杜比西·奥比主教，以及尼日尔东教区奥比奥拉·乌佐丘库主教。此前，集会讲道者艾玛·埃祖戈博士尊者敦促基督徒投入更多时间祈祷和禁食，尤其是随着12月临近。他说，祈祷能带来平安、保护和内心平静，并敦促信徒在日常生活中寻求上帝的临在。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报或该公司任何员工的观点

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body: Nyesom Wike, Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, said the people of Rivers State have chosen President Bola Tinubu as their candidate in the January 2027 presidential election. Wike said this on Saturday while welcoming Tinubu and his delegation to the Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium in Port Harcourt for the president’s campaign rally. He is the coordinator of the presidential campaign council in the state. Wike said: “Your Excellency, this is Rivers State’s rally. We did not mobilise anybody from any other state. You can see with your eyes that the people of Rivers State have already concluded and agreed that on January 16, they will vote for you. “Since the inception of democracy in 1999, Rivers people have never had it this way. We have no less than 47 political appointments from Mr President. “So, who is our brother? Our brother is Bola Ahmed Tinubu because he has identified with the people of Rivers state. He described President Tinubu as a political ally of Rivers people, saying the president had demonstrated his commitment to the state through federal projects and political appointments. He questioned the outcome of an alleged fumigation exercise in Rivers, saying it had failed to eliminate mosquitoes. “All we are saying to the vice-presidential candidate is, please, come and give an account of how you fumigated Rivers state. You fumigated Rivers state so that there would be no mosquitoes. He recalled Amaechi’s role as director-general of the presidential campaigns of former President Muhammadu Buhari. Wike said the then APC candidate failed to secure up to 15 percent of the votes in Rivers state in the 2015 and 2019 presidential elections. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body_zh: 联邦首都 territory 部长 Nyesom Wike 表示，Rivers State 人民已经选择 Bola Tinubu 作为他们在 2027 年 1 月总统选举中的候选人。Wike 周六在 Port Harcourt 的 Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium 欢迎 Tinubu 及其代表团出席总统竞选集会时说了这番话。他是该州总统竞选委员会协调员。Wike 说：“阁下，这是 Rivers State 的竞选集会。我们没有从其他任何州动员人手。您亲眼就能看到，Rivers State 人民已经作出决定并达成一致，他们将在 1 月 16 日投票支持您。‘自 1999 年民主制度建立以来，Rivers 人民从未像今天这样。我们从总统先生那里获得了不少于 47 项政治任命。‘那么，谁是我们的兄弟？我们的兄弟就是 Bola Ahmed Tinubu，因为他一直与 Rivers State 人民站在一起。’他将 Tinubu 总统形容为 Rivers 人民的政治盟友，称总统通过联邦项目和人事任命展示了对该州的承诺。他质疑了 Rivers 一次据称开展的灭蚊行动的结果，称其未能消灭蚊子。“我们对副总统候选人的全部要求就是，请他来说明自己是如何为 Rivers State 灭蚊的。他为 Rivers State 灭蚊，是为了让这里不再有蚊子。”他回顾了 Amaechi 担任前总统 Muhammadu Buhari 竞选活动总协调员的经历。Wike 说，当时 APC 候选人在 2015 年和 2019 年总统选举中均未能在 Rivers State 获得超过 15% 的选票。此处发表的意见不代表 Vanguard 报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110901.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社记者吴圭真）一项舆论调查显示，李在明总统的国政支持率在一周内小幅下降，降至30%区间中段。RealMeter受《亚洲经济》委托，于9日公布的结果显示，该调查以韩国全国18岁及以上2528人为调查对象，调查时间为2日至6日。对总统国政施政的正面评价为35.9%，较上周下降1.0个百分点。RealMeter分析称，在操纵检测特殊法被强行处理、朝野对立严重之际，后半周韩国综合股价指数跌破5000点引发股市暴跌，加之国民养老金损失争议等金融市场不安情绪叠加，国政支持率随之下降。5日至6日进行的政党支持率调查以韩国全国18岁及以上1606人为对象，结果显示执政党共同民主党支持率为36.5%，国民力量党为39.7%。祖国革新党为6.9%，改革党为2.7%，进步党为1.1%。其他政党为2.0%，无党派人士为11.1%。总统国政支持率调查样本误差在95%置信水平下为±1.9个百分点，回应率为3.0%。政党支持率调查样本误差在95%置信水平下为±3.1个百分点，回应率为3.2%。两项调查均以100%无线自动回应（ARS）方式进行。详细内容请参阅中央选举舆论调查审议委员会主页。报道请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo＜版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、发行及用于人工智能训练与使用＞2026年11月9日08:32发稿

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 随着Hanjin KAL最大股东Hoban Group持股比例上升，Delta所持14.9%股份的价值也随之提高；在董事长Cho Won-tae试图保住控制权之际，这使Delta Air Lines在围绕大韩航空控股公司的权力斗争中拥有更大筹码。截至周三，Hoban及其关联方持有Hanjin KAL 20.69%的股份 narrowly surpassing Cho及相关方的20.58%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Delta's 14.9% stake becomes more valuable as Cho Won-tae seeks to defend control Hoban Group’s rise as Hanjin KAL’s largest shareholder is giving Delta Air Lines greater leverage in the power struggle over Korean Air’s holding company as Chairman Cho Won-tae seeks to retain control. Hoban and its affiliates held a 20.69 percent stake in Hanjin KAL as of Wednesday, narrowly surpassing Cho and related parties at 20.58 percent. Cho has agreed to purchase another 325,000 shares for 37.05 billion won ($27 million), which could lift his side’s stake to 21.06 percent and restore its position as the largest shareholder. The increasingly close shareholding structure, however, has heightened the importance of major shareholders outside the two rival camps. Delta owns 14.9 percent of Hanjin KAL, while the state-run Korea Development Bank (KDB) holds 10.58 percent. Together with Cho’s stake, the three parties account for about 46 percent of Hanjin KAL. Delta has long been a strategic partner of Korean Air and is widely viewed as supportive of Cho’s leadership. The two airlines operate a trans-Pacific joint venture, while Delta has maintained a close commercial relationship with Korean Air for years. Delta's sizable stake also makes it one of the most influential shareholders outside the Cho and Hoban camps. As Hoban continues to build its stake, Cho has a stronger incentive to keep Delta firmly on his side. That could give Delta greater leverage in future discussions involving its partnership with Korean Air, including commercial cooperation and the broader direction of the combined airline following the planned integration with Asiana Airlines on Dec. 17. The timing is particularly significant because Korean Air is entering a major restructuring period. The company plans to integrate Asiana's operations in December and combine its low-cost carriers, making stable governance at Hanjin KAL increasingly important. Hoban has maintained that its investment is for simple investment purposes and has not publicly announced plans to seek management participation. Industry officials, however, say Hoban’s continued purchase of Hanjin KAL's shares suggest otherwise. For now, Delta appears to have the strongest position among Hanjin KAL’s outside strategic shareholders. Its 14.9 percent stake is large enough to matter in a control battle, while its long-standing commercial ties with Korean Air give it interests beyond a simple financial investment. “For now, Delta Air Lines is unlikely to turn against Korean Air by selling its stake, but Cho will likely keep a close eye on how the landscape will change, as he needs to leave open all the scenarios to secure management rights in Hanjin KAL,” an official from the industry said. Officials from Delta Air Lines were unavailable for comment

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110901.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）首席记者=《金融时报》7日（当地时间）援引消息人士报道称，Anthropic决定，尽管近期科技股遭遇抛售，仍将在美国感恩节假期（11月26日）之前完成首次公开募股（IPO）。消息人士预计，Anthropic将按1.2万亿至1.75万亿美元（约1700万亿至2380万亿韩元）的企业估值，筹集800亿至1000亿美元。Anthropic的一名大型投资者表示：“我们认为，它会非常保守地定价，从约1.5万亿美元起步，此后逐步提高估值。”另一名机构投资者也预计其估值约为1.3万亿美元。市场研究机构Vetal Research指出：“随着与人工智能相关的股票持续遭抛售，Anthropic的IPO将变得更加困难。这意味着为资本支出筹集资金将更加困难，最终可能引发进一步抛售的恶性循环。”据投资者介绍，尽管企业估值下降，首席执行官（CEO）达里奥·阿莫代依然会坚持推进IPO。一名早期投资者表示：“这只是整个过程中的一块里程碑。”他补充说：“与其他融资案例一样，IPO也应被视为一种融资手段。”读者可通过KakaoTalk的okjebo获取报道 <Copyright(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载或再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用> 2026/11/09 08:24发送 2026年11月9日08时24分发送

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110901.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김아람 기자 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 이스라엘 총선이 끝나자 베냐민 네타냐후 총리에게 그동안 보류됐던 가자지구 평화계획의 이행을 촉구했다고 미 인터넷매체 악시오스가 8일(현지시간) 보도했다. 소식통 2명에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 지난 5일 네타냐후 총리와 전화 통화에서 자신의 가자지구 평화계획을 이행하기 위한 조치를 해달라고 요구했다. 이 계획은 팔레스타인 무장정파 하마스의 무장해제와 가자지구 비무장화, 새로운 팔레스타인 기술관료 정부로의 통치권 이양 등을 골자로 한다. 그러나 지난달 27일 이스라엘 총선을 앞두고 수개월간 이행이 보류됐다. 트럼프 행정부는 이스라엘 총선 기간에 평화계획 이행 문제가 폭발력 있는 쟁점이 되기를 원하지 않은 것으로 전해진다. 트럼프 대통령은 총선 직전 네타냐후 총리 지지를 선언했으나, 선거가 끝난 지금은 네타냐후 총리와 야권 중 누가 새 정부를 구성하든 평화계획을 추진하기를 바라는 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프 대통령이 주도하는 평화위원회는 지난 7월 하마스를 비롯한 가자지구 무장단체들의 무장해제와 민간·치안 통제권의 팔레스타인 기술관료 정부 이양을 골자로 하는 15개 항목의 계획에 하마스와 합의했다. 하지만 네타냐후 정부는 주로 국내 정치적 이유로 이행을 사실상 거부해왔다. 네타냐후 총리는 하마스가 가자지구에서 군사조직을 재건하고 재무장하고 있다며 실제 무장해제 가능성에 강한 의구심을 드러내왔다. 한 미국 당국자는 평화계획을 단계적으로 이행할 방침이며, 하마스의 무장해제 진전이 검증된 이후 가자지구 재건이 시작될 것이라고 설명했다. 한 소식통은 트럼프 행정부와 평화위원회, 이스라엘 측 모두 이 계획이 최선의 방안이며 달리 신뢰할 만한 대안이 없다는 데 의견을 같이하고 있다고 전했다. 한편 트럼프 대통령과 네타냐후 총리가 통화한 다음 날인 6일에는 평화위원회 위원인 토니 블레어 전 영국 총리가 이스라엘을 방문했다. 블레어 전 총리는 네타냐후 총리와 새 정부 구성을 추진중인 야권 지도자 가디 아이젠코트를 만나 평화계획 이행에 협조할 것을 촉구했다고 악시오스는 전했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/09 08:14 송고 2026년11월09일 08시14분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110901.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金阿兰=美国互联网媒体Axios于8日（当地时间）报道称，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在以色列大选结束后，敦促总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡推进此前搁置的加沙地带和平计划。据两名消息人士透露，特朗普总统于5日与内塔尼亚胡总理通电话时，要求对方采取措施落实他的加沙地带和平计划。该计划主要包括解除巴勒斯坦武装组织哈马斯的武装、解除加沙地带武装，以及向新的巴勒斯坦技术官僚政府移交治理权。然而，在上月27日以色列大选前，该计划的落实已被搁置数月。据报道，特朗普政府不希望落实和平计划成为以色列大选期间的爆炸性议题。特朗普总统在大选前夕宣布支持内塔尼亚胡总理，但随着选举结束，他希望无论由内塔尼亚胡总理还是反对党人士组建新政府，都能推动和平计划。由特朗普总统主导的和平委员会于7月与哈马斯达成协议，内容涉及一项包含15项行动的计划，其中包括解除哈马斯等加沙地带武装组织的武装，以及向负责民事管理和治安的巴勒斯坦技术官僚政府移交权力。不过，内塔尼亚胡政府由于国内政治原因，实际上一直拒绝落实该计划。内塔尼亚胡总理表示，哈马斯正在加沙地带重建军事组织并重新武装，因此对实际解除武装的可能性深感疑虑。一名美国官员解释说，政府将分阶段落实和平计划，在哈马斯解除武装的进展得到核实后，才会开始重建加沙地带。一名消息人士称，特朗普政府、和平委员会和以色列方面一致认为，该计划是最佳方案，除此之外没有其他值得信赖的替代方案。另一方面，在特朗普总统与内塔尼亚胡总理通电话的次日，即6日，和平委员会委员、前英国首相托尼·布莱尔访问了以色列。据Axios报道，布莱尔前首相会见了内塔尼亚胡总理以及正在推动组建新政府的反对党领导人加迪·艾森科特，敦促他们协助落实和平计划。读者可通过KakaoTalk的okjebo获取报道 <Copyright(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载或再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用> 2026/11/09 08:14发送 2026年11月9日08时14分发送

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Lagos State Police Command has asked political parties to send it notice ahead of rallies, campaigns, processions and other political gatherings as preparations for the 2027 general elections gather pace. The Commissioner of Police, Tijani Fatai, said the notice would enable the command to make security arrangements and deploy personnel to cover the events. Mr Fatai made the appeal in a statement shared on X on Sunday by the police spokesperson, Abimbola Adebisi. He stated that the command would provide security for all political parties, candidates and their supporters without discrimination. He, however, warned that activities capable of disrupting public peace would not be tolerated. The commissioner said parties that failed to notify the police or disregarded security arrangements, resulting in a breach of peace, would be held accountable under the law. He also referred to a security meeting held on 15 October ahead of the elections, where political parties and other stakeholders were urged to cooperate with security agencies and comply with security guidelines. The police’s appeal comes against the backdrop of their statutory responsibility to provide security for political activities. Section 91 of the Electoral Act 2022 requires the police to provide adequate security for the peaceful conduct of rallies and processions. It also protects the right of registered political parties, aspirants and candidates to hold lawful rallies. Mr Fatai urged political parties to cooperate with the command to ensure that political activities across the state were conducted peacefully. The notice, as framed by the police command, is not a request for permission to conduct political activities. The position of the law based on subsisting court judgements is that police permits are not required to hold such political activities or organise protests

https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body: US President Donald Trump's administration has vowed not to change course on its mass deportation plans after last week's midterm elections defeat. "This administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities," the White House said in a statement to the BBC. Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff had signalled no climbdown from the administration on border security. Exit polls indicate immigration was the third most important issue for midterm voters, after the economy and the state of democracy. In historically conservative states like Texas, a swing of Latino voters towards Democrats helped seal the party's landslide congressional majorities. But multiple US officials sources told the BBC's US partner CBS that the administration had put the midterm losses down to concerns about the economy, affordability and the war with Iran, rather than its immigration crackdown. The White House maintained on Sunday there would be no change of direction. "There has never been a President stronger on immigration enforcement than President Trump," said White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also said it would forge ahead. "ICE is NOT backing away or slowing down," a DHS spokesperson told CBS. Following Tuesday's results, Vice-President JD Vance had appeared receptive to adjusting their immigration strategy. "I'm open to the idea that we should change enforcement - by focusing more on businesses that hire illegal labour, for instance," Vance wrote in a lengthy online post reflecting on the results. But the White House's posture appears to have hardened after Trump promoted Stephen Miller to chief of staff on Friday. Miller is widely seen as the architect of the administration's hardline immigration policy during the first and second Trump presidencies. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sources told CBS that in recent weeks officials have been instructed to aim for about 2,700 arrests of illegal immigrants per day, an increase from an earlier 2,000 daily arrest target. Enforcement sweeps this year spurred anti-ICE demonstrations in cities including Chicago, Minneapolis and Los Angeles. In Minneapolis, two US protesters, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, were fatally shot by immigration agents
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.title_zh: 白宫誓言在中期选举失利后继续加强移民执法
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政府上周中期选举失利后，誓言不会改变其大规模驱逐计划。白宫在向英国广播公司（BBC）发表的声明中表示：“本届政府不会放缓逮捕和驱逐那些恐吓我们社区的犯罪非法移民的努力。”特朗普周五提拔移民强硬派人士斯蒂芬·米勒出任白宫幕僚长，这表明该政府在边境安全政策上不会退缩。各州出口民调显示，移民问题是中期选举选民最看重的第三大问题，仅次于经济和民主状况。在得克萨斯州等历来保守的州，拉丁裔选民转向民主党，帮助该党锁定国会的压倒性多数席位。然而，多名美国官员向英国广播公司的美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）表示，政府将中期选举失利归咎于人们对经济、生活成本以及与伊朗战争的担忧，而非其收紧移民政策。白宫周日照例表示不会改变方向。白宫发言人劳伦·比斯说：“在移民执法方面，从来没有哪位总统比特朗普总统更坚定。”国土安全部（DHS）也表示将继续推进工作。一名国土安全部发言人对哥伦比亚广播公司说：“移民与海关执法局（ICE）绝不会后退或放慢行动。”周二投票结果公布后，副总统JD·万斯似乎愿意调整移民战略。万斯在一篇反思选举结果的长篇网络帖子中写道：“我愿意考虑我们是否应调整执法重点，例如更多地关注雇用非法劳工的企业。”但特朗普周五提拔斯蒂芬·米勒出任幕僚长后，白宫的立场似乎变得更加强硬。widely被视为特朗普第一和第二任总统任内强硬移民政策策划者的米勒，也是这一政策的设计者。移民与海关执法局（ICE）消息人士对哥伦比亚广播公司表示，近几周官员接到指示，每天目标是逮捕约2,700名非法移民，高于此前每日逮捕2,000人的目标。今年开展的执法突袭行动在芝加哥、明尼阿波利斯和洛杉矶等城市引发了反对移民与海关执法局的示威。在明尼阿波利斯，两名美国示威者蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷蒂被移民执法人员开枪致命打死

https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary_zh: 美国科技巨头英伟达启动独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有交往。《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄艾丽丝是北京派来的间谍。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the world's most valuable, said its board had no reason to believe its secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and is seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies. Its CEO said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. China previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting Nvidia's chief, calling the claims "groundless speculation" . US intelligence agencies monitored Alice Huang and concluded she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by The New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relation Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.title_zh: Nvidia就首席执行官涉嫌与疑似中国间谍有染展开调查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body_zh:
美国科技巨头英伟达启动了一项独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司的首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍存在关系。英伟达是全球市值最高的企业之一。公司表示，董事会没有理由相信公司的机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充称，首席执行官致力于继续领导公司。

与此同时，黄仁勋承认自己曾对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害妻子和孩子道歉。据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄爱丽是为北京效力的间谍。黄仁勋表示，他对自己所做的事承担“全部责任”，并称自己没有尽到对英伟达员工、董事会和股东的责任。他说：“我背叛了妻子。我所做的事伤害了妻子和孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

他的声明接着说：“关于新闻报道提出的国家安全问题，英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持这项调查，并将全力配合。

“我热爱我们的国家和公司。我致力于保护英伟达，并支持美国的国家安全。我很自豪，也很感激自己是一名美国人。”

英伟达董事会另行发表声明称，鉴于近期有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报行动的目标，董事会将展开调查。声明称：“董事会将美国国家和经济安全置于首位，这是压倒英伟达及其股东利益的大事。黄爱丽与黄仁勋没有亲属关系，她与总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业Megaspeed有关联。该公司上月告诉《纽约时报》，现任管理层认真对待相关指控，并已聘请外部法律顾问开展内部调查。

英伟达是人工智能基础设施领域的核心企业，向包括OpenAI和Meta在内的领先人工智能模型开发商提供芯片。这家微芯片制造商市值约4.5万亿美元，成为有史以来市值最高的公司之一。中国此前驳斥了针对英伟达首席执行官的间谍行动指控，称这些说法是“毫无根据的猜测”。

《纽约时报》援引未具名消息人士称，美国情报机构监视黄爱丽后得出结论，认为她代表中国政府行事。据报道，监视记录显示黄爱丽与一名美国公民有过通信，这名公民随后通过名为“身份揭露”的程序被确认为黄仁勋。目前尚不清楚黄爱丽——也被称为黄乐——据称向北京传递了什么信息、这些信息有多大价值，以及人们认为她从何时开始收集情报。黄爱丽没有回应该报置评请求。

上周，国会议员致函黄仁勋，要求他就这段被曝光的关系出席作证。众议院三个共和党的委员会领导人要求这位首席执行官于本月晚些时候出席，讨论英伟达“防范外国对手间谍活动的安全规程”，理由是他与黄爱丽之间被曝存在关系。信中写道：“近期报道引发了对中国获取美国敏感技术和信息这一重大国家安全问题的关注。中国渗透并获取美国尖端技术，是我们本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。”

英伟达的人工智能芯片一直是中美竞争的一个主要焦点，华盛顿此前也对该公司先进产品的销售地区实施限制。英伟达最先进的半导体产品H200此前受到华盛顿限制，原因是外界担心它会令中国科技产业获得相对于美国的优势。今年1月，特朗普政府表示，将在满足特定条件的情况下允许该公司向中国客户出售H200芯片

https://malijet.com/a_la_une_du_mali/312.body: Rechercher Contact 8 nov. 2026 | Mali-Burkina : Assimi Goïta et Ibrahim Traoré renforcent leur coopération Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent plusieurs positions terroristes à Ménaka et Kidal Refoulés de Guinée : le Premier ministre à Kouremalé, près de 17 000 personnes déjà convoyées vers le Burkina Par Malijet 8 novembre 2026 à 20:16 Le Premier ministre, le Général de Division Abdoulaye Maïga, s’est rendu à Kouremalé, à la frontière guinéenne, à la tête d’une importante délégation gouvernementale. Objectif : faire le point sur la situation des personnes refoulées de Guinée et renforcer leur accueil, leur sécurité, leur assistance et l’organisation de leur retour. L’information a été donnée par le Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC), dans un communiqué publié le 8 novembre 2026. Selon le communiqué, les arrivées vers Bamako restent stables et ralentissent à Kouremalé. Mais d’autres régions accueillent aussi des refoulés : près de 5 000 dans la région de Bougouni (Yanfolila, Sélingué et Kalana), 500 dans la région de Kita et 400 dans celle de Kayes, surtout à Kéniéba. Les opérations de retour se poursuivent à un rythme soutenu. Le samedi 7 novembre, le Mali a mobilisé 63 camions et 39 bus pour transporter environ 14 000 personnes vers le Burkina Faso, tandis que 48 bus burkinabè ont permis le retour de près de 3 000 autres. Ce dimanche 8 novembre, 54 camions et 24 bus maliens, ainsi que 38 cars burkinabè, ont repris la route. Sur place, des vivres et d’autres biens de première nécessité ont été distribués à Bamako et à Kouremalé. Les structures de santé de Bamako ont réalisé 760 consultations, et 232 personnes ont été transférées de Kéniéba vers la capitale. Le CECOGEC salue l’élan de solidarité des services de l’État, des partenaires et des populations. Il demande toutefois aux personnes et organisations qui souhaitent aider de passer par les structures techniques compétentes, afin que les dons soient bien gérés et répartis selon les besoins

https://malijet.com/a_la_une_du_mali/312.body_zh: 搜索 联系方式 2026年11月8日｜马里—布基纳法索：阿西米·戈伊塔和易卜拉欣·特拉奥雷加强合作 道古科洛科行动：马里武装部队在梅纳卡和基达尔打击多处恐怖分子阵地 几内亚难民遭驱逐：总理前往库雷马莱，已有近17,000人被运送至布基纳法索 Par Malijet 2026年11月8日20:16 总理、陆军少将阿卜杜拉耶·迈加率领一个重要的政府代表团抵达了几内亚边境的库雷马莱。此次访问旨在了解从几内亚遭驱逐人员的最新情况，并加强对他们安置、安全、援助及返乡组织工作的落实。危机协调与管理中心（CECOGEC）于2026年11月8日发布公报，公布了这一消息。公报称，前往巴马科的难民抵达人数保持稳定，在库雷马莱的速度有所放缓。但其他地区也在接收被驱逐人员：布古尼地区（扬福利拉、塞林盖和卡拉纳）近5,000人，基塔地区500人，凯斯地区400人，其中多数集中在凯涅巴。返乡行动正以稳定速度继续。11月7日星期六，马里调动63辆卡车和39辆巴士，将约14,000人运送至布基纳法索，布基纳法索方面的48辆巴士则帮助近3,000人返乡。11月8日星期日，马里的54辆卡车、24辆巴士以及布基纳法索的38辆长途客车再次上路。在巴马科和库雷马莱，当地已向难民分发食品和其他基本生活物资。巴马科的医疗结构共完成760次问诊，另有232人从凯涅巴转移至首都。CECOGEC对国家机关、合作伙伴和民众展现出的团结互助精神表示赞赏。不过，该中心也呼吁希望提供援助的个人和组织通过主管技术机构进行对接，以确保捐赠得到妥善管理，并按照实际需求进行分配

https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.summary: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, has said the African Democratic Congress (ADC) will participate in the 2027 general elections, but warned that candidates produced by the David Mark-led faction, including former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, may not appear on the ballot. Keyamo said the fate of the candidates would depend on the final determination of the party’s leadership dispute by the Supreme Court.
https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.summary_zh: 航空与航天发展部长费斯图斯·凯亚莫表示，非洲民主大会（ADC）将参加2027年大选，但警告由戴维·马克派系推举的候选人，包括前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔，可能不会出现在选票上。凯亚莫表示，这些候选人的命运将取决于最高法院对该党领导权争端作出的最终裁决。
https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.body: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, has said the African Democratic Congress (ADC) will participate in the 2027 general elections, but warned that candidates produced by the David Mark-led faction, including former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, may not appear on the ballot. Keyamo said the fate of the candidates would depend on the final determination of the party’s leadership dispute by the Supreme Court. The minister stated this in a post on his verified X handle on Sunday, following concerns that a recent Federal High Court judgment against the Mark-led leadership could prevent the opposition party from fielding candidates in the elections. The Federal High Court in Abuja had on Thursday nullified the Mark-led National Working Committee and invalidated decisions taken by the faction, including the presidential primary that produced Atiku as the ADC’s candidate for the 2027 election. The judgment followed a suit filed by former ADC Deputy National Chairman (North-East), Nafiu Gombe, in which he challenged the process through which Mark and other members of the caretaker committee assumed control of the party. Gombe argued that following the resignation of former National Chairman, Ralph Nwosu, he was constitutionally entitled to take over the party’s leadership. Reacting to the ruling, Keyamo dismissed suggestions that it meant the ADC would be excluded from the 2027 elections. “For the education of the public, those raising false alarm that the court judgment on ADC means the party will not be on the ballot are spreading misinformation. “The ADC will be on the ballot. It is the David Mark faction of candidates, including Atiku Abubakar, that may not be on the ballot, depending on the final judgment of the Supreme Court,” he said. The minister also questioned why the judgment was being portrayed as an attempt to prevent the opposition party from participating in the elections. He argued that candidates who emerged through the party’s original leadership structure should not be denied their political rights because of the dispute. “Therefore, the question we must ask those raising hell is: are those Nigerians who successfully won their primaries under the faction of the original owners of the ADC lesser humans or lesser Nigerians than David Mark and Atiku Abubakar?” he asked. Meanwhile, the Mark-led faction has rejected the judgment and vowed to challenge it in court. Atiku and the party have also indicated plans to appeal the ruling. The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has said it would not take a position on the dispute until it obtains and studies the certified true copy of the judgment. The outcome of the pending appeals is expected to determine which faction has the legal authority to control the ADC and nominate candidates for the 2027 general elections. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.body_zh: 航空与航天发展部长费斯图斯·凯亚莫表示，非洲民主大会（ADC）将参加2027年大选，但警告由戴维·马克领导的派别推举的候选人，包括前副总统阿蒂库·阿布巴卡，可能不会出现在选票上。凯亚莫说，这些候选人的命运将取决于最高法院对该党领导层争端的最终裁决。周日，他在经过认证的X账号上发帖称此事。此前，外界担心，联邦高等法院针对马克领导层的近期判决可能阻碍这个反对党在选举中推出候选人。阿布贾联邦高等法院周四撤销了马克领导的全国工作委员会，并宣布该派别作出的决定无效，包括推选阿蒂库为ADC参加2027年选举候选人的总统初选。该判决源于ADC前副全国主席（东北区）纳菲乌·贡贝提起的诉讼。贡贝在诉讼中质疑马克及其他看守委员会成员接管该党的程序。贡贝认为，前全国主席拉尔夫·恩沃苏辞职后，他依照宪法有权接管该党领导层。针对这项裁决，凯亚莫否定了所谓这意味着ADC将被排除在2027年选举之外的说法。他说：“为了让公众明白，那些谎称法院关于ADC的判决意味着该党不会出现在选票上的人，正在散布错误信息。‘ADC将出现在选票上。可能不会出现在选票上的是戴维·马克派系的候选人，包括阿蒂库·阿布巴卡，这取决于最高法院的最终判决。’部长还质疑，为何这项判决被描述为企图阻止该反对党参加选举。他认为，通过该党原有领导层架构胜出的候选人，不应因争端而被剥夺政治权利。他问道：“因此，我们必须向那些大肆鼓噪的人提出的问题是：那些在ADC原有派系下成功赢得初选的尼日利亚人，难道比戴维·马克和阿蒂库·阿布巴卡低人一等，或不是真正的尼日利亚人吗？”与此同时，马克领导的派别拒绝接受该判决，并誓言要在法庭上提出挑战。阿蒂库和该党也表示计划对这项裁决提起上诉。独立国家选举委员会（INEC）表示，在取得并研究判决经认证的真实副本之前，不会对争端表明立场。尚待审理的上诉结果预计将决定哪个派别拥有控制ADC并为2027年大选提名候选人的合法权力。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取全天候更新 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 埃兹拉·乌坎瓦是《领导报》的数字新闻编辑，拥有五年多涵盖新闻业、数字化媒体和政治报道的专业经验。这名受过路透社培训、屡获殊荣的记者曾任《先锋报》高级记者，也曾任Legit.ng时政与政治编辑。他拥有拉各斯锚点大学大众传播理学学士学位、纳萨拉瓦州宾厄姆大学发展传播学硕士学位，并且是尼日利亚管理学会（NIM）和尼日利亚公共关系学会（NIPR）的成员

https://leadership.ng/2027-three-demands.title: 2027: Three Demands Vulnerable Nigerians Are Asking Tinubu, Obi, Atiku, Sowore Ahead of Polls
https://leadership.ng/2027-three-demands.summary: From unemployed graduates and struggling small business owners to farmers, persons with disabilities, elderly citizens and low-income households, the message to political parties is increasingly clear: Nigerians want policies that improve their daily lives, not another round of campaign promises.
https://leadership.ng/2027-three-demands.summary_zh: 从失业毕业生、陷入困境的小企业主，到农民、残障人士、老年公民和低收入家庭，各政党收到的信息日益明确：尼日利亚人希望看到改善日常生活的政策，而不是又一轮竞选承诺。
https://leadership.ng/2027-three-demands.body: For millions battling rising food prices, unemployment, expensive transportation, poor electricity and insecurity, the coming election represents another opportunity to demand better governance. From unemployed graduates and struggling small business owners to farmers, persons with disabilities, elderly citizens and low-income households, the message to political parties is increasingly clear: Nigerians want policies that improve their daily lives, not another round of campaign promises. The rising cost of living remains one of the biggest concerns among citizens. Food, rent, transportation and healthcare costs have placed enormous pressure on household budgets, leaving many families struggling to meet basic needs. Olufemi Adeniyi, a community leader in Abeokuta, said the next president must understand that governance should be measured by improvements in people’s living conditions. “Our leaders must understand that governance is ultimately about improving the quality of life of the people. Nigerians deserve affordable food, decent housing, accessible healthcare, and a government that genuinely prioritises their welfare,” he said. For Abiodun Yakubu, a digital and communications strategist, Nigerians are no longer interested in explanations about economic challenges without corresponding improvements in their lives. “People are tired, hungry and gradually losing hope,” he said, calling for policies that would make food affordable, improve purchasing power and create decent employment. He added: “Nigerians are not asking for luxury; they simply want to be able to feed their families.” Insecurity has also become a major concern, particularly for farmers and rural communities affected by kidnappings, banditry and attacks. Many farmers are unable to access their farmlands safely, while traders and commuters face the risk of attacks on highways. Waheed Saka, convener of Dialogue 365, said security, stable electricity and employment should be among the next president’s priorities. He said: “I will love that next Nigeria’s President prioritises security across the country.” He also supported the establishment of state police, provided adequate safeguards were introduced to prevent abuse. For young Nigerians, unemployment and the absence of meaningful economic opportunities remain pressing issues. Abiodun Yakubu said many graduates had resorted to informal activities because decent jobs were difficult to find. “Millions of graduates are either unemployed or engaged in informal activities such as commercial tricycle operations and point-of-sale businesses because decent employment opportunities are unavailable,” he said. He called for genuine job creation, support for small businesses and skills programmes that lead to employment rather than initiatives that exist mainly on paper. Beyond economic hardship, persons with disabilities are demanding that the 2027 elections give them equal opportunities to participate in the democratic process. For many, the challenge begins long before they reach the ballot box. Inaccessible polling units, inadequate assistive devices, communication barriers and discrimination have continued to discourage participation. Kemi Odusanya, a visually impaired voter, recalled that although she participated in the 2019 elections, the absence of Braille ballot papers could create difficulties for some voters. A physically challenged voter and disability advocate, Sussan Kelechi Ihuoma, described her experience of accessing a polling unit as stressful. “As a person with physical disability, getting to the polling unit was stressful aside from the fact that the voting area was not easily accessible,” she said. She warned that such difficulties could discourage eligible voters from participating. “Sometimes it looks like a person deciding not to attempt the journey at all,” she said, describing how previous negative experiences could make people question whether voting was worth the stress. INEC Chairman, Prof. Joash Amupitan, has acknowledged the challenges, warning that insecurity, discrimination and inaccessible polling units could prevent persons with disabilities from exercising their rights. “Electoral inclusion is not an act of charity; it is a democratic obligation,” he said. For small business owners, unreliable electricity means additional spending on generators, petrol and diesel, costs that are eventually transferred to consumers. Nnamdi Orie, a technology entrepreneur, said stable electricity, affordable healthcare, quality education and better infrastructure should be central to the next administration’s agenda. “People want to afford decent meals, travel without fear of kidnapping, find meaningful employment and run businesses without spending a fortune on diesel,” he said. He added that Nigeria must move from an economy driven largely by consumption to one built on production, manufacturing, agriculture and exports. On healthcare, Francisca Ogar, a journalist, called for functional primary healthcare facilities, including services for elderly citizens. She also identified insecurity, unemployment, electricity, education and the cost of living as issues requiring urgent attention. For Ebelechukwu Kingsley, Nigerians should not have to sell their belongings or travel abroad to access proper medical treatment. “People should not have to sell their belongings or travel abroad before they can receive proper medical treatment. Our public hospitals need to work, and basic healthcare should be affordable,” he said. Political analyst Dr Hashim Saludeen said Nigeria was confronting not only an economic crisis but also a crisis of governance, public trust and national cohesion. He argued that the next president must prioritise security, economic recovery, education, healthcare, employment, justice and accountable leadership. “Economic recovery must also be felt in households rather than merely reflected in government statistics,” he said. Saludeen added that Nigerians needed a government that could protect lives and livelihoods while ensuring that public institutions worked for everyone. Similarly, legal practitioner Evans Ufeli said the next administration must provide measurable solutions to inflation, unemployment, insecurity and poor public services. Although their experiences differ, the demands of struggling Nigerians converge around a common expectation: a government that makes survival less difficult. They want affordable food, safer communities, decent jobs, reliable electricity, functional hospitals, quality schools and leaders who can be held accountable for their decisions. As the 2027 campaigns gather momentum, candidates will be expected to explain not only what they intend to do but how they plan to achieve it and how Nigerians can measure their performance. For citizens already struggling to survive, another cycle of attractive manifestoes and political promises may not be enough. The ultimate test of the next administration, they insist, will be whether an ordinary Nigerian can afford a meal, earn a decent living, travel safely, access healthcare and send children to school without sinking deeper into poverty. https://leadership.ng/2027-three-demands.title_zh: 2027年：脆弱的尼日利亚人在投票前向Tinubu、Obi、Atiku和Sowore提出三项要求
https://leadership.ng/2027-three-demands.body_zh: 对于数百万正在应对食品价格上涨、失业、交通昂贵、电力匮乏和缺乏安全感的民众而言，即将举行的选举是再次要求改善治理的契机。从失业毕业生、艰难维持的小企业主，到农民、残障人士、老年公民和低收入家庭，传递给各政党的信息日益明确：尼日利亚人希望看到改善日常生活的政策，而不是又一轮竞选承诺。生活成本上涨仍是公民最担忧的问题之一。食品、房租、交通和医疗费用给家庭预算带来巨大压力，许多家庭难以满足基本生活需要。阿贝奥库塔社区领袖奥卢费米·阿德尼伊表示，下一任总统必须明白，治理应以人民生活条件的改善来衡量。他说：“我们的领导人必须明白，治理归根结底是为了改善人民的生活质量。尼日利亚人应享有负担得起的食物、体面的住房、便利的医疗，以及真正优先保障其福祉的政府。”数字与传播战略专家阿比奥敦·亚库布表示，如果经济困境没有带来相应的生活改善，尼日利亚人已不再 interested于听取有关经济挑战的解释。他说：“人们已经疲惫、饥饿，并逐渐失去希望。”他呼吁制定政策，使食品价格可以承受、提高购买力并创造体面的就业机会。他补充道：“尼日利亚人并不奢求奢侈品；他们只是希望能够养活家人。”不安全问题也日益成为重大关切，尤其是受到绑架、匪徒活动袭击影响的农民和农村社区。许多农民无法安全进入自己的农田，商贩和通勤者则面临公路遭袭的风险。Dialogue 365召集人瓦希德·萨卡表示，安全、稳定供电和就业应列入下一任总统的优先事项。他说：“我很希望下一任尼日利亚总统把全国各地的安全作为优先事项。”他还支持设立州警察，但前提是引入充分保障措施以防止权力滥用。对年轻尼日利亚人而言，失业和缺乏有意义的经济机会仍是紧迫问题。阿比奥敦·亚库布表示，由于难以找到体面的工作，许多毕业生不得不从事非正规活动。他说：“数百万毕业生要么失业，要么从事经营商用三轮车和销售点业务等非正规活动，因为没有体面的就业机会。”他呼吁真正创造就业岗位、支持小型企业，并推动能够带来就业的技能培训，而不是流于纸面的计划。除经济困境外，残障人士要求2027年选举让他们拥有平等机会参与民主进程。对许多人而言，挑战早在他们抵达投票站之前就已开始。投票站无法进入、辅助设备不足、沟通障碍和歧视，持续削弱着残障人士的参与意愿。视力受损选民凯米·奥杜桑亚回忆，尽管她参加了2019年选举，但没有盲文选票，仍可能给一些选民造成困难。身体残障选民兼残障权益倡导者苏桑·凯莱奇·伊霍马称，她前往投票站的过程令人倍感压力。她说：“作为一名身体残障人士，前往投票站本就很艰难，而且投票区域也不便进入。”她警告称，此类困难可能使符合条件的选民放弃参与。她说：“有时看起来，一个人会觉得干脆不去走这一趟。”她解释道，往日的负面经历会让人怀疑投票是否值得承受这些压力。独立国家选举委员会（INEC）主席乔阿什·阿穆皮坦教授承认了这些挑战，并警告称，不安全、歧视和投票站无法进入，可能妨碍残障人士行使权利。他说：“选举包容不是慈善行为，而是民主义务。”对小型企业主而言，供电不稳定意味着要在发电机、汽油和柴油上投入更多开销，而这些成本最终会转嫁给消费者。科技创业者恩纳姆迪·奥里表示，稳定供电、可负担的医疗、优质教育和更好的基础设施，应成为下一届政府议程的核心。他说：“人们希望吃上价格合理的饭菜，出行时不必担心遭到绑架，找到有意义的工作，并能在经营生意时不必花一大笔钱购买柴油。”他还补充，尼日利亚必须从主要由消费驱动的经济，转向以生产、制造业、农业和出口为基础的经济。在医疗方面，记者弗朗西斯卡·奥加呼吁建设能够正常运转的初级医疗设施，包括为老年公民提供相关服务。她还将不安全问题、失业、电力、教育和生活成本列为需要紧急处理的问题。针对埃贝莱丘库·金斯利，尼日利亚人不应不得不变卖财物或前往国外才能获得适当的医疗服务。他说：“人们不该为了接受适当的医疗而变卖财物或远赴海外。我们的公立医院必须正常运转，基本医疗也应当价格可负担。”政治分析人士哈希姆·萨卢丁博士表示，尼日利亚不仅面临经济危机，也面临治理、公共信任和国家凝聚力危机。他认为，下一任总统必须优先处理安全、经济复苏、教育、医疗、就业、司法和问责领导等事务。他说：“经济复苏也必须让家庭切身感受到，而不能仅仅反映在政府统计数据中。”萨卢丁补充说，尼日利亚人需要一个既能保护生命和生计，又能确保公共机构为所有人服务的政府。同样，律师埃文斯·乌费利表示，下一届政府必须为通货膨胀、失业、不安全问题和公共服务质量低下提供可衡量的解决方案。尽管各自经历不同，困境中的尼日利亚人有着共同诉求：建立一个让生存不再那么艰难的政府。他们希望获得价格合理的食物、更安全的社区、体面的工作、可靠的电力、能正常运转的医院、优质学校，以及能够就其决定问责的领导人。随着2027年竞选活动不断升温，人们不仅期待候选人说明自己打算做什么，还会要求其解释打算如何实现，以及尼日利亚人如何衡量其施政表现。对于已经在生存线上挣扎的公民而言，再一轮动听的Manifesto和政治承诺或许仍不够。他们坚称，对下一届政府的终极考验，将是普通尼日利亚人能否买得起一顿饭、靠体面的工作获得收入、安全出行、获得医疗服务并让孩子上学，同时不至于陷入更深的贫困。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP Gold may have put Mali on the map, but lithium is now adding another important dimension to the country’s mining story.
https://stockhead.com.au/resources/gold-.summary_zh: 如今，黄金仍是马里经济和采矿业的重要组成部分。全球最大的黄金生产商之一巴里克矿业在马里西部运营Loulo-Gounkoto综合体。黄金或许让马里登上世界舞台，但锂如今又为该国的采矿业增添了另一个重要维度。
https://stockhead.com.au/resources/gold-.body: Mali’s history of mining stretches back centuries to the days of the Mali Empire and its legendary ruler Mansa Musa. Musa is regarded as one of the world’s richest people to have ever lived, with his fortune built on the empire’s gold and salt trade. He famously passed through Cairo on a pilgrimage to Mecca in the 14th century, giving away so much gold that it reportedly depressed the metal’s value for years. Today, gold remains integral to Mali’s economy and mining sector. Barrick Mining, one of the world’s largest gold producers, operates the Loulo-Gounkoto complex in western Mali. Canadian heavyweights B2Gold and Allied Gold also churn out the metal in the country. On the ASX, Africa-focused producer Resolute Mining (ASX:RSG) is targeting between 150,000 ounces and 160,000 ounces of output in 2026 from its Syama mine. Toubani Resources (ASX:TRE) could be the next ASX gold producer in the nation, with first pour at its Kobada project targeted for next year. Gold may have put Mali on the map, but lithium is now adding another important dimension to the country’s mining story. Chinese giant Ganfeng commenced production at its Goulamina mine in late 2024, with UK-listed Kodal Minerals and its Chinese partner Hainan Mining bringing their Bougouni project online last year. ASX explorer First Lithium (ASX:FL1) is also on the hunt for lithium at its Faraba and Gouna projects. Previous drilling at Gouna returned a series of notable strikes at the priority Blakala prospect, including 111m at 1.57% Li2O. The recent renewal of both exploration licences has cleared the way for the company to advance a maiden resource estimate. West Africa is considered one of the world’s most prospective gold provinces. Its mineral wealth is underpinned by the West African Craton, a geological terrane often compared with WA’s prolific Yilgarn Craton. Most of the region’s major gold deposits are associated with Birimian greenstone belts. These features stretch across several countries, including Mali, and have helped transform Ghana into one of the world’s biggest gold producers and the largest in Africa. West Africa’s potential has not gone unnoticed by the world’s leading gold miners, with the likes of Newmont Corporation (ASX:NEM) , AngloGold Ashanti and Barrick operating in the region. In Mali, Barrick’s 80% owned Loulo-Gounkoto complex includes the Yalea and Gara underground mines and the Gounkoto open pit. The remaining 20% of the operation is owned by the Malian government, which has sought to increase its share of the country’s mineral wealth through reforms to its mining code. Barrick expects its share of production to total between 260,000 and 290,000 ounces in 2026. The project hosts about 6.9Moz in reserves and about 11Moz in resources. B2Gold’s 80%-owned Fekola mine achieved first gold pour in 2017. It has since served up more than 4Moz, with 390,000-420,000 ounces targeted from the broader Fekola complex in 2026. Allied Gold is guiding for production of at least 200,000 ounces in 2026 from its majority-owned Sadiola mine. The asset hosts nearly 7Moz in reserves. Amongst the ASX contingent, Resolute brought its Syama project to life in 2018. It still contains 3.9Moz in reserves and 9.1Moz in resources. Elsewhere, Toubani is targeting first production at Kobada in the third quarter of next year. A recent DFS outlined a 9.2-year operation with annual production of about 162,000 ounces. The project currently holds a 2.2Moz resource with further exploration potential. Mali’s lithium-bearing pegmatites have also been attracting investor interest over the past few years. Ganfeng shipped its first concentrate from Goulamina last June and is now ramping up production. A planned expansion is targeting annual production capacity of 1Mt lithium concentrate. The company initially partnered with ASX-listed Leo Lithium in 2021 to advance the project. It acquired Leo’s remaining 40% stake for about US$343 million in 2025, before the Malian government secured a 35% interest under a revised mining agreement. Goulamina is regarded as one of the world’s largest hard-rock lithium deposits, with a resource totalling 299Mt at 1.33% Li2O. Meanwhile, Kodal and Hainan produced first concentrate at Bougouni in February 2025. The first stage of production entails 125,000 tonnes of concentrate per annum over four years. A proposed second-stage flotation plant is expected to extend the mine life by more than 10 years and lift output to 230,000 tonnes per annum. Bougouni holds a resource totalling 31.9Mt at 1.06% Li2O, with further exploration potential. First Lithium has also identified exploration upside at its Faraba and Gouna tenements, sitting about 50km apart in southern Mali. Multiple spodumene-bearing pegmatites have been identified across the two projects. At Gouna, previous drilling delivered a series of significant intercepts along 1.3km of strike of the main pegmatite body at Blakala. Drilling in 2023 returned 111m at 1.57% Li2O from 33m and 60m at 1.59% Li2O from 39m. Subsequent results included 41m at 1.91% Li2O from 80m and 37m at 1.79% Li2O from 88m. The company is now targeting a maiden resource before the end of the year after securing licence renewals for both projects for a further three years. At Stockhead, we tell it like it is. https://stockhead.com.au/resources/gold-.title_zh: 黄金让马里登上地图，但锂业新时代正在地平线上升起
https://stockhead.com.au/resources/gold-.body_zh: 马里的采矿历史可追溯数百年，早至马里帝国及其传奇统治者曼萨·穆萨统治时期。穆萨被视为有史以来世界上最富有的人之一，其财富来自帝国的黄金和盐业贸易。14世纪，他曾在赴麦加朝觐途中途经开罗，并慷慨散放大量黄金，据报这使金价多年低迷。如今，黄金仍是马里经济和采矿业的重要组成部分。全球最大黄金生产商之一巴里克矿业在马里西部运营Loulo-Gounkoto综合矿。加拿大大型金矿企业B2Gold和Allied Gold也在该国生产黄金。在澳交所上市的非洲-focused生产商Resolute Mining（ASX:RSG）计划其Syama矿在2026年的产量达到150,000盎司至160,000盎司。Toubani Resources（ASX:TRE）可能成为该国下一家澳交所黄金生产商，其Kobada项目计划于明年进行首次浇铸。黄金或许让马里声名鹊起，但锂如今正为该国采矿业增添另一个重要维度。中国巨头赣锋于2024年底开始在其Goulamina矿生产，英国上市公司Kodal Minerals及其中国合作伙伴Hainan Mining于去年使Bougouni项目投产。澳交所勘探企业First Lithium（ASX:FL1）也在其Faraba和Gouna项目中寻找锂矿。此前在Gouna的钻探于重点Blakala矿点取得一系列显著矿化，包括111米、氧化锂含量1.57%。近期两项勘探许可证均获续期，为该公司推进首次资源量估算铺平了道路。西非被认为是全球最具黄金勘探潜力的地区之一。其矿产资源基础是西非克拉通，这一地质构造带常与西澳大利亚州高产的伊尔冈克拉通相提并论。该地区多数大型金矿床都与比里米亚绿岩带有关。这些地质带横跨包括马里在内的多个国家，并推动加纳成为全球最大黄金生产国之一以及非洲最大的黄金生产国。西非的潜力已引起全球领先金矿企业的关注，Newmont Corporation（ASX:NEM）、AngloGold Ashanti和巴里克等企业均在该地区运营。在马里，巴里克持有80%权益的Loulo-Gounkoto综合矿包括Yalea和Gara地下矿以及Gounkoto露天矿。该项目其余20%权益由马里政府持有；马里政府一直寻求通过改革采矿法，提高本国在国家矿产财富中所占的份额。巴里克预计，其权益对应的2026年总产量将达到260,000盎司至290,000盎司。该项目拥有约6.9Moz储量及约11Moz资源量。B2Gold持有80%权益的Fekola矿于2017年实现首次黄金浇铸，此后累计产金超过4Moz，2026年目标是整个Fekola综合矿产量达到390,000盎司至420,000盎司。Allied Gold预计其控股的Sadiola矿2026年产量至少达到200,000盎司。该资产拥有近7Moz储量。澳交所阵营中，Resolute于2018年启动Syama项目，该项目仍拥有3.9Moz储量和9.1Moz资源量。与此同时，Toubani计划于明年第三季度在Kobada实现首次生产。近期DFS列明该项目运营期为9.2年，年产量约162,000盎司。目前该项目拥有2.2Moz资源量，并有进一步勘探潜力。过去几年，马里含锂伟晶岩也日益受到投资者关注。赣锋去年6月从Goulamina运出首批精矿，目前正逐步提高产量。计划中的扩建工程目标是将年产能提升至1Mt锂精矿。该公司最初于2021年与澳交所上市公司Leo Lithium合作推进该项目，并在2025年以约3.43亿美元收购Leo剩余40%股权，随后马里政府依据修订后的采矿协议取得35%权益。Goulamina被视为全球最大的硬岩锂矿床之一，资源总量为299Mt，氧化锂含量为1.33%。与此同时，Kodal和Hainan于2025年2月在Bougouni生产出首批精矿。第一阶段生产计划在四年内达到每年125,000吨精矿。拟建第二阶段浮选厂预计将矿山寿命延长10年以上，并将产量提高至每年230,000吨。Bougouni资源总量为31.9Mt，氧化锂含量为1.06%，并具有进一步勘探潜力。First Lithium还在其位于马里南部、相距约50公里的Faraba和Gouna矿区发现了勘探潜力。两个项目中已识别出多条含锂辉石的伟晶岩。在Gouna，此前钻探沿Blakala主要伟晶岩体1.3公里走向取得一系列重要截矿。2023年钻探从33米处取得111米、氧化锂含量1.57%的矿化，并从39米处取得60米、氧化锂含量1.59%的矿化。后续结果包括从80米处取得41米、氧化锂含量1.91%的矿化，以及从88米处取得37米、氧化锂含量1.79%的矿化。在为两个项目取得进一步三年期许可证续期后，该公司目前正争取在年底前完成首次资源量估算。在Stockhead，我们直言不讳。First https://leadership.ng/zamfara-moves-to-r.body: The Zamfara State Government has taken a decisive step to reclaim its gold fields from illegal miners and criminal elements with the inauguration of a 13-man Anti-Illegal Mining Committee. The committee was inaugurated on Friday in Gusau, the state capital, by the Secretary to the State Government (SSG), Malam Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada. The move is part of the state government’s renewed effort to support the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector, restoring order in mining communities, and cutting off the funding source for banditry and terrorism in the state. The committee is headed by the State Commissioner for Environment, Hon. Abdulrahman Tumbido. It draws membership from security agencies, traditional institutions, and relevant federal and state government agencies — a structure the government says will ensure coordination, intelligence sharing and effective enforcement across all mining areas. Inaugurating the committee, Nakwada charged members to work closely with security agencies, regulatory bodies and local authorities to identify locations where illegal mining is taking place and profile the operators. He said the committee must also ensure that even licensed companies comply with relevant laws and regulations, take adequate measures to prevent environmental degradation, and safeguard the safety and rights of host communities. “The initiative is part of the state government’s efforts to assist the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector in the state,” Nakwada said. In his remarks, the Chairman of the Committee, Hon. Tumbido, assured that the committee would work with reliable information, respect for the law, fairness and regard for the rights and livelihoods of the people. He added that the committee would ensure its efforts contribute to lasting security, environmental protection and sustainable development in the state. The inauguration comes against the background of worsening insecurity in mining communities in Anka Local Government Area. On October 15, elderly residents of Birnin Doki in Anka LGA were reportedly ordered out of their homes by terror leader Muhammad Gwaska for allegedly refusing forced labour in the gold mines controlled by his gang. Displaced residents said they were forced to walk about 15 kilometres to an abandoned clinic, with no food, water or immediate state aid. Residents in the area have also alleged that terror groups now control some gold fields, decide who mines, who farms and who lives there, and tax farmers and miners to fund further attacks. The state government says the new committee is part of its response to dismantle that criminal economy, restore state authority in mining areas, and protect vulnerable communities like Birnin Doki from exploitation. Zamfara is one of Nigeria’s richest gold belts, but years of illegal mining have fuelled insecurity, environmental degradation and exploitation of host communities. With the inauguration of the committee, the state government says it is moving from rhetoric to action — to ensure that Zamfara’s mineral wealth works for its people, not for criminals. "The visit brought together senior U.S. Navy and Marine Corps leaders to assess naval shipbuilding capabilities, installation infrastructure and logistics support across South Korea," read a photo caption of one of the uploaded photos on the Pentagon's Defense Visual Information Distribution Service (DVIDS). The delegation included Brendan P. Rogers, assistant secretary of the U.S. Navy for energy, installations and environment; U.S. Marine Corps Lt. Gen. Andrew M. Niebel, deputy commandant for installations and logistics; and U.S. Marine Corps Maj. Gen. Valerie A. Jackson, commander of U.S. Marine Corps Forces Korea. As part of the itinerary, the delegation also assessed opportunities to strengthen maritime sustainment, enhance operational readiness and reinforce the Korea-U.S. alliance, according to DVIDS. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 执政党一名官员周日在政府表示，政府已同意考虑拨款约2万亿韩元（15亿美元），用于消防工作相关的必要投资。朴表示，用于筹备消防设备和训练设施的额外预算资金，以及加强以消防工作为核心的医疗体系，也将纳入明年预算审查的考量。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The government has agreed to consider funding about 2 trillion won ($1.5 billion) for essential investments related to firefighting efforts, a ruling party official said Sunday. The move came as part of discussions to ease the fiscal burden on provincial governments, Democratic Party of Korea chief spokesperson Park Sung-joon said at a press briefing following a consultation session between the government, the ruling party and Cheong Wa Dae. Additional budget funds to prepare firefighting equipment and training facilities, as well as strengthening a medical system centered on firefighting efforts, will also be factored in for a review of next year's budget, Park said. Currently, provincial governments fund the bulk of the firefighting-related budget, with only about 10 percent of the total amount funded by the central government. At the meeting, Prime Minister Han Seong-sook said the government will review whether it is providing full support for firefighters before asking them to devote themselves to public safety. In the meeting, held a day ahead of the 64th anniversary of the Day of Firefighting, Han paid tribute to the late Kim Jin-seok, a firefighter who died while responding to a factory fire in Bucheon, west of Seoul, last month. "There are many things for the government to take care of, but the lives and safety of the public are one of the top priorities. There is nothing that precedes this," Han said. Han, meanwhile, vowed to thoroughly inspect preparations for the winter cold, stressing that heavy snow and cold are natural disasters that threaten people's daily lives
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 政府将审查为消防工作提供的15亿美元资金支持
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 执政党官员周日表示，政府已同意考虑为消防工作相关的必要投资提供约2万亿韩元（15亿美元）资金。朝鲜民主党首席发言人朴成浚在政府、执政党与青瓦台举行磋商后举行的新闻发布会上表示，此举是为减轻地方政府财政负担而展开讨论的一部分。朴说，政府还将把为消防装备和训练设施筹备预算资金，以及加强以消防工作为核心的医疗体系等事项，纳入明年预算审查。目前，消防相关预算的大部分由地方政府承担，中央政府出资仅约占总额的10%。在会议上，国务总理韩升洙表示，政府将审查是否已为消防员提供全面支持，然后才要求他们致力于公共安全。在会议当天，即消防节64周年纪念日的前一天，韩升洙向已故金镇锡致祭。金镇锡是一名消防员，上个月在首尔以西富川处理一家工厂火灾时牺牲。韩升洙说：“政府需要处理的事情很多，但公众的生命和安全是首要任务之一，没有什么能比这更重要。”与此同时，韩升洙承诺将彻底检查应对寒冬的准备情况，强调大雪和严寒是威胁人们日常生活的自然灾害

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: [COVER STORY] Korea's chip-driven growth faces risks from potential US data center curbs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Korea is facing growing concerns that a sharp stock market decline triggered by fears of U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction could spill over into the real economy, as such curbs, if implemented, could threaten semiconductor exports and weigh on next year’s growth, analysts said Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 分析师周日表示，韩国正面临越来越多的担忧：因市场担忧美国将限制人工智能数据中心建设而引发的股市大幅下跌，可能外溢至实体经济；如果实施此类限制，可能威胁韩国半导体出口，并拖累明年的增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea is facing growing concerns that a sharp stock market decline triggered by fears of U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction could spill over into the real economy, as such curbs, if implemented, could threaten semiconductor exports and weigh on next year’s growth, analysts said Sunday. The Democrats’ victory in the U.S. midterm elections last week has fueled speculation that the party could push for tighter oversight of data center projects, although specific measures have yet to be announced. Korea’s economy has benefited substantially from the global AI boom this year, with strong semiconductor exports providing a major boost to growth. Semiconductors accounted for 49 percent of the country’s total exports in October, and the Bank of Korea (BOK) estimates that the industry will contribute roughly half of the country's economic growth this year. These concerns have already taken a toll on Korean stocks. Both the benchmark KOSPI and secondary bourse Kosdaq lost 10.43 percent and 8.54 percent, respectively, over the three trading sessions following the U.S. midterm elections, from Wednesday to Friday. Samsung Electronics fell 14.03 percent, while SK hynix tumbled 19.03 percent. A prolonged stock market slump could erode household wealth and further weaken private consumption, which declined in the third quarter despite stronger-than-expected economic growth. The economy grew 1 percent from the previous quarter, well above the central bank's forecast of 0.3 percent, its advance estimate showed. While semiconductor exports and equipment investment supported growth, household spending declined 0.2 percent, with purchases of both goods and services falling. He added that the extent of the economic impact would depend largely on the scope and severity of any restrictions. “Close attention should be paid to whether policymakers and lawmakers seek to halt data center construction altogether or instead allow projects to proceed under stricter requirements,” he said. Potential changes to U.S. data center policy have added uncertainty to Korea’s growth outlook for 2027. The BOK projected Korea's economy to grow by 2.9 percent next year in its August forecast. The state-run Korea Development Institute and the Ministry of Finance and Economy both forecast 2.2 percent, in August and July respectively. The International Monetary Fund projected 2.8 percent growth in October, and the OECD forecast 2.6 percent in September. The outlook could change depending on the scope of any U.S. restrictions and their impact on AI infrastructure investments. Later this month, the central bank is set to release updated economic projections, which the government is expected to reflect in its economic policy plan for next year. The developments in the U.S. are being closely watched by Samsung Electronics and SK hynix, both of which are expanding their manufacturing operations there. Texas, where Samsung Electronics is building a new foundry, has drawn particular attention following the midterm elections. Democrats Gina Hinojosa and James Talarico won the state's gubernatorial and Senate races, respectively. Hinojosa has called for conditions on taxes, electricity rates, water use and construction labor for newly approved data center projects, though she noted that projects that have already received approval can proceed. Long-term supply agreements between chipmakers and major customers could help cushion any near-term fluctuations in demand. However, much will depend on how U.S. policy takes shape and whether new restrictions affect projects already in the pipeline
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 封面故事：韩国由芯片驱动的增长面临美国可能限制数据中心的风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国正面临越来越多的担忧：因市场担忧美国可能限制人工智能（AI）数据中心建设而引发的股市大跌，可能外溢至实体经济。分析人士周日表示，此类限制一旦实施，可能威胁韩国半导体出口，并拖累明年的增长。上周美国中期选举中，民主党获胜，这加剧了外界猜测：该党可能推动对数据中心项目实施更严格的监管，尽管目前尚未公布具体措施。今年全球人工智能热潮显著带动韩国经济，强劲的半导体出口为增长提供了主要支撑。10月，半导体占该国出口总额的49%；韩国银行（BOK）估计，该行业今年将贡献该国约一半的经济增长。这些担忧已经对韩国股市造成打击。在美国中期选举后的三个交易日，即周三至周五期间，主要指数KOSPI和二级市场KOSDAQ分别下跌10.43%和8.54%。Samsung Electronics下跌14.03%，SK hynix重挫19.03%。股市长期低迷可能侵蚀家庭财富，并进一步削弱私人消费；第三季度私人消费下降，尽管经济增长强于预期。央行预估数据显示，经济环比增长1%，远高于央行此前预测的0.3%。半导体出口和设备投资支撑了增长，但家庭支出下降0.2%，商品和服务购买量均出现下滑。他补充称，经济受影响程度将在很大程度上取决于任何限制措施的范围和严厉程度。他说：“应密切关注政策制定者和议员究竟是寻求彻底叫停数据中心建设，还是允许项目在更严格的要求下继续推进。”美国数据中心政策可能发生的变化，为韩国2027年的增长前景增添了不确定性。韩国银行在8月的预测中预计韩国经济明年增长2.9%。国有机构韩国开发研究院和财政经济部分别在8月和7月预测增长2.2%。国际货币基金组织10月预测增长2.8%，经济合作与发展组织9月预测增长2.6%。前景可能因美国限制措施的范围及其对人工智能基础设施投资的影响而发生变化。本月晚些时候，央行将发布 updated 经济预测，预计政府将在明年的经济政策计划中反映这些预测。Samsung Electronics和SK hynix正密切关注美国的发展局势，两家公司都在扩大其在该国的制造业务。中期选举后，Samsung Electronics正在那里新建晶圆厂的得克萨斯州引起了特别关注。民主党人Gina Hinojosa和James Talarico分别赢得该州州长和联邦参议员选举。Hinojosa主张对新建数据中心项目的税收、电价、用水和建筑用工设置附加条件，但她指出，已经获得批准的项目可以继续推进。芯片制造商与主要客户之间的长期供应协议，有助于缓冲近期需求波动。然而，最终结果将很大程度上取决于美国政策的形成方式，以及新限制措施是否影响已经进入实施阶段的项目

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Coupang faces pressure to broaden US lobbying strategy after midterms
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. Industry officials said Coupang could step up its lobbying efforts in the U.S. as it seeks to defend itself against regulatory pressure in Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权后，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 周日，专家和业内人士表示，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，Coupang在美国扩大游说策略、拓展共和党盟友以外政治关系的压力日益增加。业内人士表示，Coupang可能会加大在美国的游说力度，以抵御韩国监管压力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. The change could be particularly impactful for the e-commerce giant, whose lobbying efforts have helped draw attention in Washington to its dispute with Korean regulators. Republican lawmakers, including members of the House Judiciary Committee, have publicly criticized what they described as discriminatory treatment of the U.S.-headquartered firm in Korea. With Democrats now set to control both chambers of Congress, the institutional backing Coupang has received from Republican lawmakers is expected to weaken, prompting experts and industry watchers to say the company will have to broaden its relationships across both parties to maintain its influence in Washington. “Especially for a digital-focused firm like Coupang, which remains subject to policies under the Republican administration, it is important to balance lobbying efforts between Democrats and Republicans,” said Shin Won-kyu, head of the global economic research team at the Federation of Korean Industries. Coupang's political spending already shows signs of such a shift. According to political contribution records filed with the Federal Election Commission, COUPAC, a political action committee established by Coupang to support U.S. congressional candidates, contributed $185,000 (252 million won) to members of Congress and affiliated political organizations during the first three quarters of this year, up 18.2 percent from a year earlier. Of this year's contributions, $107,000 went to Democratic lawmakers, Democratic-affiliated election organizations and political action committees, while $78,000 went to Republicans and their affiliated groups. Coupang's contributions to Democrats jumped 52.9 percent from a year earlier, while those to Republicans fell 9.8 percent. The figures indicate that the company had already stepped up its overall political spending ahead of the midterms, anticipating a Democratic victory. The shift suggests Coupang had begun preparing for a possible change in the balance of power. "Coupang should pursue lobbying on roughly a 50-50 basis to maintain a balance in the U.S.," said Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University. “U.S. President Donald Trump is still a Republican, while Democrats now control both chambers of Congress.” The need for a bipartisan strategy is closely tied to the nature of Coupang's regulatory dispute in Korea. The company has faced scrutiny from Korean authorities over its handling of a massive data breach and other alleged business malpractices, and some U.S. lawmakers have raised concerns about whether Korean regulators are treating U.S. companies fairly. In July, Republican Rep. Michael Baumgartner, a vocal supporter of Coupang in Congress, introduced a bill that would bar foreign government officials from entering the U.S. if they engage in economic discrimination against U.S. companies. He won reelection in Washington state, but will return to a House controlled by Democrats — underscoring the need for Coupang to expand its lobbying reach beyond Republican allies. Industry officials said Coupang could step up its lobbying efforts in the U.S. as it seeks to defend itself against regulatory pressure in Korea. “Korean regulatory authorities show no signs of backing down from their hard-line stance against Coupang’s data breach or other unfair business activities, so the company will rely more on U.S. lobbying to raise its voice against Korean authorities,” an industry official said. A Coupang spokesperson declined to comment on the details of its U.S. lobbying strategy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 中期选举后，Coupang面临扩大美国游说战略的压力
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 专家和行业官员周日报道称，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，电商巨头Coupang面临越来越大的压力，需要将其在美国的游说策略从共和党盟友扩大到其他阵营。这一变化对这家电商巨头的影响可能尤其显著，因为其游说努力曾帮助提请华盛顿关注该公司与韩国监管机构的争端。包括众议院司法委员会成员在内的共和党议员，曾公开批评他们所称的美国总部设在韩国的企业遭受歧视性待遇。随着民主党即将控制国会两院，Republican议员给予Coupang的机构支持预计将减弱，促使专家和行业观察人士表示，该公司必须扩大与两党的关系，才能维持在华盛顿的影响力。 韩国商工联会全球经济研究团队负责人Shin Won-kyu表示：“尤其是对于Coupang这样一家以数字业务为主的公司而言，其业务仍受共和党政府政策约束，因此在民主党和共和党之间平衡游说努力十分重要。” Coupang的政治支出已经显现出这种转变的迹象。根据提交给联邦选举委员会的政治献金记录，Coupang为支持美国国会候选人而成立的政治行动委员会COUPAC，今年前三个季度向国会议员及其关联政治组织捐出185,000美元（2.52亿韩元），较上年同期增长18.2%。今年捐款中，107,000美元流向民主党议员、民主党关联选举组织和政治行动委员会，78,000美元则流向共和党及其关联团体。Coupang对民主党的捐款较上年同期跃升52.9%，对共和党的捐款则下降9.8%。这些数字显示，公司在中期选举前已加大整体政治支出，预判民主党将取得胜利。这一转变表明，Coupang已经开始为权力格局可能发生的变化做准备。 世宗大学工商管理学教授Kim Dae-jong表示：“Coupang应当以大约五五开的比例开展游说，以维持在美国内部的平衡。”“美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍是共和党人，而民主党现在控制着国会两院。” 采取两党战略的需要与Coupang在韩国所面临监管争端的性质密切相关。该公司因处理大规模数据泄露及其他涉嫌不当商业行为而受到韩国当局审查，一些美国议员则担忧韩国监管机构是否公平对待美国企业。7月，共和党众议员Michael Baumgartner在国会上大力支持Coupang，并提出一项法案，禁止对实施经济歧视的美国企业的外国政府官员进入美国。他在华盛顿州成功连任，但将回到由民主党控制的众议院，这进一步凸显了Coupang需要将游说触角扩大到共和党盟友之外。 行业官员表示，Coupang正在寻求抵御韩国的监管压力，因此可能加大在美国的游说力度。一名行业官员说：“韩国监管机构没有迹象表明会放弃针对Coupang数据泄露及其他不公平商业活动的强硬立场，因此该公司将更多依靠美国游说活动来反对韩国当局。” Coupang发言人拒绝对其美国游说策略的细节置评

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Defense committee chair says OPCON agreement stands despite US midterm outcome
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策有关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权移交首尔，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，根据商定条件推进移交。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday. Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), who chairs the National Assembly’s National Defense Committee, briefed reporters at the National Assembly on the outcome of a parliamentary delegation’s trip to the United States from Nov. 1 to 5. He said the delegation was granted entry approval only at the last minute, but was still able to proceed with its scheduled visit to U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and its subordinate component commands in Hawaii. Asked whether the Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections could affect the OPCON transfer process, Jin said he did not expect any significant changes. "Korea and the U.S. have discussed and reached agreements over OPCON transfer for more than 20 years. A Democratic victory (in the U.S.) would not affect the existing bilateral agreements," he said. Regarding the postponement of the Security Consultative Meeting between Korea and the U.S., originally scheduled for November, until next year, Jin cited U.S. officials saying the delay was unrelated to any differences over the OPCON transfer. "The U.S. said the decision was made after taking into account the two countries' defense ministers' and senior military officials' schedules," he added. Jin said U.S. officials assessed the security situation on the Korean Peninsula as stable, despite a series of North Korean actions in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), including the demolition of inter-Korean connecting roads and the fortification of areas along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). "However, the officials stressed the need to maintain military readiness, citing North Korea's growing nuclear and missile capabilities and the possibility of abrupt policy shifts," said Jin. Adm. Stephen T. Koehler, commander of the U.S. Pacific Fleet, reportedly said Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines could strengthen the alliance, expressing willingness to cooperate pending policy decisions by both governments. On Seoul’s request for cooperation in relocating Gwangju Air Base to build a mega semiconductor cluster, Gen. Kevin B. Schneider, commander of Pacific Air Forces, said the relocation is a sovereign decision for the Korean government, while the U.S. military's role is to assess and advise on potential military risks. Asked whether United States Forces of Korea Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson came up in the talks, Jin said he did, but declined to elaborate. Brunson recently drew criticism from ruling party lawmakers after he said, at a seminar in Washington on Oct. 14, that Korea begins at the southern boundary fence line of the DMZ from the perspective of the United Nations Command. The remark sparked controversy because it could be interpreted as placing Korea’s territorial boundary at the southern edge of the DMZ, 2 kilometers south of the MDL. The southern half of the DMZ, which includes villages where South Korean residents live, lies north of that line
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 国防委员会主席称，尽管美国中期选举结果如何，OPCON协议仍然有效
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策相关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权（OPCON）移交首尔的时间，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，在既定条件下推进移交。执政的韩国民主党的金成埈议员担任国会国防委员会主席，他在国会向记者介绍国会代表团于11月1日至5日访问美国的成果。他说，该代表团直到最后一刻才获准入境，但仍得以按计划访问美国印太司令部及其下属驻夏威夷各司令部。记者问，美国中期选举中民主党获胜是否可能影响OPCON移交进程，金成埈表示，他预计不会出现重大变化。他说：“韩国和美国就OPCON移交问题已经讨论并达成协议超过20年。民主党（在美国）获胜不会影响现有双边协议。”谈及原定于11月举行、后推迟至明年的韩美安全磋商会议，金成埈援引美国官员的话称，推迟与双方在OPCON移交问题上的分歧无关。他补充说：“美国表示，这一决定是在考虑两国国防部长和高级军事官员的日程后作出的。”金成埈说，尽管朝鲜在非军事区（DMZ）采取一系列行动，包括拆除南北连接道路以及在军事分界线沿线加固设施，美国官员仍评估朝鲜半岛安全局势保持稳定。金成埈说：“不过，这些官员强调必须维持战备状态，理由是朝鲜的核与导弹能力不断增强，其政策也可能突然转向。”据报道，美国太平洋舰队司令斯蒂芬·T·科勒海军上将表示，韩国发展核动力潜艇的努力能够加强同盟，并表示愿意在两国政府作出政策决定前提供合作。应首尔请求，为建设大型半导体产业集群而合作搬迁光州空军基地，太平洋空军司令凯文·B·施奈德将军表示，搬迁是韩国政府的主权决定，而美国军队的职责是评估潜在军事风险并提供建议。记者问，驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军是否在会谈中被提及，金成埈表示确有提及，但拒绝进一步说明。布伦森最近受到执政党议员批评。他于10月14日在华盛顿的一场研讨会上表示，从联合国司令部角度看，韩国始于非军事区南侧围栏线。这番言论引发争议，因为它可能被解读为把韩国的领土边界划在非军事区南缘，即军事分界线以南2公里处。非军事区南半部包括有韩国居民居住的村庄，位于该界线以北

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 韩国股市遭遇“黑色星期五”，亟需改革。韩国股市最近的“黑色星期五”引发熔断机制与卖方停牌机制同时启动，主要交易所指数下跌逾6%。与此同时，上周中期选举后立即上涨的美国股市指数也出现下跌。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Benchmark KOSPI heavyweights SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also took a hit, with their shares falling 10.44 percent and 6.35 percent, respectively, as investors sold in panic, driving the index below 5,000 during trading. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell. Investors and policymakers woke up to a changed economic climate, triggered by a shift in the U.S. political landscape. Any optimism that last week's U.S. midterm elections had reaffirmed the country’s democratic values was tempered by concerns over the Democrats’ agenda to regulate artificial intelligence (AI) and restrict data center construction. A deeper concern is that these policy shifts come amid growing skepticism over whether the AI boom is actually a bubble and whether massive investments in the sector will ultimately generate profits. Other Asian stock markets, including Taiwan's, also declined Friday. But Seoul’s heavy reliance on its semiconductor sector amplified market volatility, which was pushed up even higher by President Lee Jae Myung's strong pledge to tackle the so-called "Korea discount." In response to the sharp decline, senior officials from Korea’s economic, financial regulatory and monetary agencies convened to discuss emergency measures, including a three-month exemption from collateral reserve requirements on loans to investors in an effort to curb further selling. The measure may for the time being bring some peace to investors, but they now depressed and distrustful are also likely to be wary of government measures. Aggressive investments in AI and a sustained drive in the U.S. to build data centers also contributed to the strong performance by Korea's top chipmakers. But the market landscape has shifted, as has the balance of power in the U.S. Congress. The episode should prompt Korea and its financial authorities to pursue more fundamental reforms to guard against future market shocks. Structural reforms take time, but with the Korean economy forecast to grow by around 3 percent this year, the country must use that momentum to diversify its economic base and reduce its vulnerability to external shocks. We have repeatedly called for greater economic diversification, particularly to reduce the concentration of semiconductors in Korea’s exports and stock market. Exports of semiconductors including high-bandwidth memory and conventional memory chips are estimated to account for about 40 percent of the country’s total exports, which are on track to reach a record $1 trillion as early as this month. SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also make up about 40 percent of KOSPI's total market capitalization. This structure cannot continue to drive sustainable growth for Korea, nor can it produce the surplus profits that fill government coffers. At the same time, Korea cannot afford to lose its competitive edge in semiconductors and must continue investing in research, development and innovation, as reflected in the government’s plans for three major semiconductor projects. The surplus profits from the current chip boom gave the government the confidence to pursue its "three megaprojects," but it still needs future growth engines. Policymakers should focus on deregulation to revive the automotive, shipping and battery sectors, while fostering an environment for emerging sectors such as robotics, biotechnology and small modular reactors to become new engines of growth
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 美国中期选举结果影响韩国股市指数
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 韩国股市经历“黑色星期五”，凸显改革需求。韩国股市近期经历“黑色星期五”，主要交易所综合指数跌幅超过6%，熔断机制与卖方临时停牌机制同时启动，市场陷入恐慌。基准指数KOSPI的权重股SK hynix和Samsung Electronics也遭重创，股价分别下跌10.44%和6.35%。投资者恐慌抛售，指数在交易期间跌破5,000点。与此同时，上周美国中期选举结束后一度上涨的美国各大股指也出现下跌。投资者和政策制定者醒来后面对的是一种已经改变的经济环境，其诱因是美国政治格局的转变。上周美国中期选举重新确认该国民主价值观，本应令人们感到乐观，但民主党监管人工智能（AI）和限制数据中心建设的议程引发了担忧。更深层的忧虑在于，人们日益怀疑人工智能热潮是否真是一股泡沫，以及对该行业的大规模投资最终能否创造利润。包括台湾在内的其他亚洲股市周五也出现下跌。然而，首尔过度依赖半导体行业，加剧了市场波动；李在明总统大力承诺解决所谓的“韩国折价”，进一步推高了波动。为应对这一急跌，韩国经济、金融监管和货币机构的高层官员召开会议，讨论应急措施，包括对投资者贷款实施3个月的抵押品准备金要求豁免，以遏制进一步抛售。这项措施或许能暂时安抚投资者，但当前情绪低落、疑虑重重的投资者也可能对政府措施保持警惕。对人工智能进行激进投资，以及美国持续推动建设数据中心，也助力韩国头部芯片制造商取得亮眼表现。然而，市场格局已经改变，美国国会中的权力平衡也是如此。这一事件应促使韩国及其金融 authorities推进更为根本的改革，以防范未来的市场冲击。结构性改革需要时间，而预计韩国经济今年将增长约3%，该国必须利用这一势头实现经济基础多元化，降低对外部冲击的脆弱性。我们反复呼吁推进更大程度的经济多元化，尤其是降低半导体在韩国出口和股市中的集中度。包括高带宽内存和传统存储芯片在内的半导体出口，据估计约占该国出口总额的40%；出口总额最早有望在本月达到创纪录的1万亿美元。SK hynix和Samsung Electronics还合计占KOSPI总市值约40%。这种结构无法继续为韩国推动可持续增长，也无法创造充盈政府财政的过剩利润。与此同时，韩国不能失去在半导体领域的竞争优势，必须继续投资研发和创新；政府计划推进的3个大型半导体项目正体现了这一点。当前芯片热潮带来的过剩利润使政府有信心推进其“三大超级项目”，但韩国仍需打造未来的增长引擎。政策制定者应重点推进放松管制，以重振汽车、航运和电池行业，同时为机器人、生物技术和小型模块化反应堆等新兴行业营造环境，使其成为新的增长引擎
