https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: Humanity wins USA midterm elections, but the Trump menace remains, By Owei Lakemfa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: President Donald Trump of the United States, US still appears dazed from the severe electoral blows he received from his fellow citizens in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Trump and his fellow MAGA lost the elections for various reasons including the fact that they could not understand that inflation is biting hard in the country. Generally, the outcome of the US midterm elections, is a plus for the human race.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在2026年中期选举中遭到本国民众重创后，美国似乎仍处于惊愕之中。特朗普及其 fellow MAGA 因多种原因在选举中失利，其中包括他们未能认识到通胀正严重侵蚀该国。总体而言，美国中期选举的结果对人类有益。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Generally, the world has been made far less safe by Trump, the American voters are aware of this and, want to reclaim their country from the MAGAs. They demonstrated this by employing their votes. Ironically, many Republicans may not be unhappy with the turn of events as they also want to reclaim their party, or what is left of it, from the riotous MAGA mob. President Donald Trump of the United States, US still appears dazed from the severe electoral blows he received from his fellow citizens in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Living under messianic illusions, he cannot believe and, is yet to come to terms that the aura of indispensability he created around himself has evaporated. He first accepted the humiliating defeat which has set Democrats firmly in the leadership seats of the Congress and the Senate where his fellow Republicans lost seven seats. Then he issues threats: “Democrats will send things that are insane and I will veto them.” He may not have realized that the new Senate is not the old one that pampered and, allowed him to get away with mass murders including burying Iranian school children under the rubbles of their classrooms or, playing Al Pacino-like gangsterism across the globe. Trump and his fellow MAGA lost the elections for various reasons including the fact that they could not understand that inflation is biting hard in the country. When I was in the US in October, common complaints I heard included rising costs of grocery and fuel. The people were also tired of gangsterism in the streets by the Immigration and Customs Enforcement, ICE agents. Even as Trump and his allies talked glibly about war in Iran, the American citizenry seemed war-weary. Ironically, Trump appeared to have misread the situation. On 2 November, the eve of the elections, he said there had been no US attacks against Iran in two months and wandered whether this was actually a war. He thought the best way to bolster the low Republican ratings in the polls was to immediately attack Iran. He did that day, unaware that he was further digging his political grave. As we say in Nigeria, he was actually pouring petrol to the fire roasting the Republicans. He also might not have realized that the rising global cries against war, were reaching receptive ears in the US. He claims the rising prices of oil in the world due to his undeclared war against Iran, have benefited the US as the country makes more money from oil including the crude theft of Venezuelan oil. But his knowledge of economics is so limited that he did not realise that the war and unstable crude oil prices has led to global economic crises which are pushing the boundaries of inflation in the US itself. In other words, the resultant global economic downturn also has negative effects in the streets of the US. Also, the global tariff wars inflicted by Trump on various countries including neighbouring Canada and far away China, have also negatively affected the US and, many Americans are tired of wars whether economic, military or anti-immigrant. Trump might have had the delusion that he is a modern day American Cowboy, gunslinging and wiping out bad boys like the Iranian leadership. He did not realise that such behaviour was what was to be ashamed about not, glorified. So, with the US unable to protect its allies in the Gulf when the Iranians retaliated, traditional European countries ignoring Trump calls to rally and jointly invade Iran and, the US inability to even protect the Strait of Hormuz, US had lost face. Basically, it is losing the war against Iran and, not a few Americans are unaware. There is also the issue of Trump portraying the US as being so lawless and cowardly, that without declaring war, it invaded the bedroom of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, abducting him and his wife, Cilia Adela Flores. Today, he holds them in US detention without being able to press the so-called charges of drug running against them. Instead, all the US is doing is, shadow-boxing, holding the couple illegally, preventing elections from being held in Venezuela and stealing that country’s oil and gas. The American voters are also weary of their country being isolated globally even by traditional European allies against whom Trump threatened war in order to seize the Danish colony of Greenland. Generally, the world has been made far less safe by Trump, the American voters are aware of this and, want to reclaim their country from the MAGAs. They demonstrated this by employing their votes. Ironically, many Republicans may not be unhappy with the turn of events as they also want to reclaim their party, or what is left of it, from the riotous MAGA mob. Another issue that affected the Republicans was the choice or imposition of candidates. For instance, it had former Texas Attorney General Ken Warren Paxton as its Senatorial candidate in Texas. The challenge was that Paxton had on 28 July, 2015 been indicted by a grand jury on three criminal charges. Two of the counts were on securities fraud (a first degree felony) and the third, for failing to register with state securities regulators. This 63-year old, was a contrast with the 37-year-old Democratic candidate, James Dell Talarico, a former high school English Language teacher and advocate of increased school funding. Talarico secured 5,445,121 or 55.1 per cent of the votes and, Paxton, 4,249,752 or 43 per cent. Another case was Michael Whatley, said to be very supportive of Trump. He ran for Senate in North Carolina and got 1,643,088 votes while Democratic candidate, Roy Cooper won with 2,467,963 votes. But the Trump effect was not all round negative. The voters reaction to him might also have produced some positive results. For instance, it produced Keisha Lance Bottoms as the first Black Woman Governor in 250 years of US history and, Democrat, Deb Haaland of New Mexico as the first Native American woman Governor in US history. It also produced the first Muslim Senator, First female Native Senator and first Gen Z woman in Congress. For us in Nigeria, four Nigerian-Americans won elections in Maryland, Washington, Texas and Pennsylvania. World reaction to the changes in the US are as expected, varied. Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei does not foresee any fundamental shift in US policy towards his country. He therefore declared: “Those who still harbour even the slightest hope that the behaviour of the hegemonic system might change through partisan or factional shifts, or who imagine that making concessions to the United States can dissuade it from hostility towards the Iranian nation, are seriously mistaken.” The hope of the European Union is the continuation and prolongation of the Russo-Ukrainian War. Its Vice President Kaja Kallas said she hopes the new Congress will continue supporting Ukraine. This is in contrast to Trump’s salutary efforts to end the senseless bloodshed. Generally, the outcome of the US midterm elections, is a plus for the human race. We look forward to a safer, saner world with Trump safely out of the White House. Owei Lakemfa , a former secretary general of African workers, is a human rights activist, journalist and author
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 人类在美国中期选举中获胜，但特朗普的威胁依然存在，作者：奥韦伊·拉凯姆法
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 总体而言，特朗普让这个世界变得远不如过去安全，美国选民对此心知肚明，并希望从MAGA阵营手中夺回自己的国家。他们通过投票表达了这一意愿。讽刺的是，许多共和党人未必会为事态的这一变化感到不满，因为他们也想从这个躁动不安的MAGA人群手中夺回自己的政党，或夺回政党仅剩的部分。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在2026年中期选举中遭到同胞的沉重打击后，似乎仍处于恍惚状态。他一直活在救世主式的幻想中，无法相信自己尚未接受一个事实：他在自己周围营造的不可或缺感已经消散。他起初接受了这羞辱性的失败，这次失败使民主党人稳稳占据了国会和参议院的领导席位，而共和党的同胞议员则失去了7个席位。随后，他发出威胁：“民主党人会上交一些疯狂的东西，我会否决它们。”他可能没有意识到，新一届参议院已经不同于过去那个纵容他、让他得以逍遥法外的大规模谋杀得以发生，包括把伊朗学童埋在教室废墟下，或像阿尔·帕西诺式的黑帮分子一样在全世界横行。特朗普和他的MAGA同僚之所以在选举中失败，原因多种多样，其中包括他们未能理解通胀正给这个国家带来严重冲击。10月我在美国时，听到的普遍抱怨包括食品杂货和燃料价格上涨。民众也厌倦了美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）特人员在街头实施黑帮式执法。就在特朗普及其盟友轻率地谈论对伊朗开战时，美国公众似乎也已厌倦战争。讽刺的是，特朗普似乎误判了局势。11月2日，也就是选举前夕，他表示美国已有两个月没有袭击伊朗，并怀疑这实际上算不算战争。他认为，提升共和党民调支持率的最佳办法，就是立即攻击伊朗。当天他果真这么做了，却不知道这样只会进一步挖掘自己的政治坟墓。用我们尼日利亚人的话说，他实际上是在往烤焦共和党人的火上浇油。他可能还没有意识到，全球反对战争的呼声正在美国得到回应。他声称，由于他对伊朗发动了未宣战的世界油价上涨，让美国受益，因为美国通过石油赚了更多钱，这也包括盗取委内瑞拉原油。但他的经济学知识极其有限，以至于没有意识到，战争和不稳定的原油价格已引发全球经济危机，并把美国自身的通胀推向更高水平。换言之，随之而来的全球经济衰退也对美国街头的民众造成了负面影响。此外，特朗普对包括邻国加拿大和遥远的中国在内的多个国家挑起的全球关税战，也对美国造成了负面影响；许多美国人已经厌倦了各种战争，无论是经济战、军事战，还是反移民战。特朗普或许产生了错觉，以为自己是现代版美国牛仔，持枪逞强并消灭伊朗领导层之类的坏人。他没有意识到，这种行为应当令人羞耻，而不是受到颂扬。因此，在伊朗人报复时美国无力保护海湾盟友、传统欧洲国家无视特朗普集结力量共同入侵伊朗的号召、美国甚至无力保护霍尔木兹海峡的情况下，美国已经颜面尽失。归根结底，它正在输掉对伊朗的战争，而且不少美国人并未意识到这一点。另一个问题是，特朗普把美国描绘成一个如此无法无天、如此懦弱的国家，以至于它在没有宣战的情况下便侵入委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的卧室，绑架了他和妻子西莉亚·阿德莱·弗洛雷斯。如今，美国在不让二人获释的情况下将他们关押在境内拘留设施中，却无法就所谓贩毒罪名提出指控。美国所做的一切不过是打影子拳、非法拘禁这对夫妇、阻止委内瑞拉举行选举，以及窃取该国的石油和天然气。美国选民也厌倦了本国在全球遭到孤立，就连特朗普曾以战争相威胁、企图夺取丹麦殖民地格陵兰的传统欧洲盟友，也与其保持距离。总体而言，特朗普让这个世界变得远不如过去安全，美国选民对此心知肚明，并希望从MAGA阵营手中夺回自己的国家。他们通过投票表达了这一意愿。讽刺的是，许多共和党人未必会为事态的这一变化感到不满，因为他们也想从这个躁动不安的MAGA人群手中夺回自己的政党，或夺回政党仅剩的部分。另一个影响共和党的因素，是候选人的选择或强行指定。例如，共和党让得克萨斯州前总检察长肯·沃伦·帕克斯顿担任该州的联邦参议员候选人。问题在于，帕克斯顿曾于2015年7月28日被大陪审团以三项刑事罪名起诉。其中两项是证券欺诈（一级重罪），第三项是未向州证券监管机构登记。这位63岁候选人与37岁的民主党候选人詹姆斯·戴尔·塔拉里科形成了鲜明对比；后者曾是一名高中英语教师，主张增加学校经费。塔拉里科获得5,445,121票，占55.1%；帕克斯顿获得4,249,752票，占43%。另一个案例是迈克尔·沃特利，据说他是特朗普的坚定支持者。他在北卡罗来纳州竞选参议员，获得1,643,088票，而民主党候选人罗伊·库珀以2,467,963票胜出。不过，特朗普效应并非在所有方面都是负面。选民对他的反应或许也产生了一些积极结果。例如，它促成了基沙·兰斯·博特姆斯成为美国250年历史上首位黑人女性州长，也促成了新墨西哥州民主党人黛布·哈兰成为美国历史上首位美国原住民女性州长。它还促成了首位穆斯林参议员、首位女性原住民参议员和国会首位Z世代女性。对我们尼日利亚人而言，有4名尼日利亚裔美国人分别在马里兰州、华盛顿州、得克萨斯州和宾夕法尼亚州赢得选举。世界对美国这些变化的反应一如预期，呈现多种姿态。伊朗最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊预计美国对伊朗的政策不会发生任何根本性转变。因此，他宣称：“那些仍然怀有一丝希望，以为霸权体系的行为可能因党派或派系变动而改变，或者以为向美国作出让步便能阻止其对伊朗民族抱持敌意的人，都大错特错了。”欧盟方面则希望俄乌战争继续并延长。其副主席卡娅·卡拉斯说，她希望新一届国会继续支持乌克兰。这与特朗普为结束无谓流血而作出的有益努力形成鲜明对比。总体而言，美国中期选举的结果对人类而言是一桩好事。我们期待着一个更安全、更理智的世界，也期待特朗普安全地离开白宫。奥韦·拉肯法是非洲劳工组织前秘书长、人权活动家、记者和作家。

https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.summary: Amid unprecedented disruptions to global energy markets since the outbreak of the Iran war at the end of February, stronger policy support and intensified energy security concerns are driving faster deployment of renewable power across India, Southeast Asia, Africa and the Middle East. For the first time, the amount of renewable power capacity added in emerging and developing economies outside China is expected to match the amount added in advanced economies in the forecast period.
https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.summary_zh: 自2月底伊朗战争爆发以来，全球能源市场遭受前所未有的冲击。更有力的政策支持和不断加剧的能源安全担忧，正推动印度、东南亚、非洲和中东加快部署可再生能源发电。预测期内，中国以外新兴和发展中经济体新增的可再生能源发电装机容量预计将首次达到发达经济体新增装机容量的水平。
https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.body: No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result by Chika Izuora 7 seconds ago in Business The International Energy Agency (IEA) has provided fresh insight into global renewable energy developments , showing renewable capacity increase in emerging and developing economies outside China matching that in advanced economies for the first time as Hormuz crisis sharpens focus on domestic energy sources Renewables, already expanding at a record pace before the current energy crisis, are set to see strong growth across a wider range of countries around the world in the coming years as governments seek to strengthen energy security and reduce their exposure to imported fuels and volatile prices, according to the IEA’a latest report. Renewables 2026, this year’s edition of the IEA’s annual report on the sector, sees global renewable power capacity increasing by almost 4 800 gigawatts (GW) in the 2026-2031 period, almost 60% more than was added in the previous six-year period. Solar PV is set to account for more than three-quarters of global renewable capacity growth to 2031, followed by onshore wind. Amid unprecedented disruptions to global energy markets since the outbreak of the Iran war at the end of February, stronger policy support and intensified energy security concerns are driving faster deployment of renewable power across India, Southeast Asia, Africa and the Middle East. For the first time, the amount of renewable power capacity added in emerging and developing economies outside China is expected to match the amount added in advanced economies in the forecast period. China will remain the largest contributor to the global increase in renewable power capacity, but its share is set to decline from over 60% in 2025 to an average of 53% over the forecast period amid changes to its renewable energy policies. India is emerging as the world’s second-largest growth market, with its total renewable capacity set to more than double by 2031. Growth is also increasing across Southeast Asia, the Middle East and North Africa, and sub-Saharan Africa. Across these regions, the amount of renewable capacity added in the 2026-2031 period is forecast to almost triple compared with the previous six-year period. “Previously, environmental concerns were the policy priority behind the growth of renewables, whose falling costs have made them a competitive option in many markets – but today, it’s mainly energy security that is driving renewables’ expansion as more and more countries seek to reduce their exposure to imported fuels,” said IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol. “The new chapter of the renewables growth story is a truly global one as their deployment spreads well beyond major markets into every corner of the world. This is making them a key pillar of the global power sector. Today, they account for a third of global electricity generation; in the next five years, they will be getting closer to half of it.” The growth in renewable power additions is not only the result of major installations by utilities and developers; it is also being driven directly by consumers in many countries. Faced with high fuel prices and unreliable electricity supplies in some markets, households and small businesses around the world are increasingly turning to more affordable rooftop solar PV systems that can be installed quickly. These small-scale installations have already helped improve electricity services for around 70 million households worldwide, the report finds. The report forecasts that the use of renewable energy for transport will rise by more than 60 per cent by 2031, by which point it will cover 6 per cent of the transport sector’s energy demand worldwide. Renewable electricity used by electric vehicles accounts for around 45 per cent of this increase, while biofuels are making the second-largest contribution. As an immediate response to high fuel prices and availability challenges, several countries, notably in Southeast Asia and Latin America, have raised blending mandates, which set the minimum proportion of biofuels that has to be blended into gasoline or diesel sold at the pump. Our forecast for biofuels is revised up by 40% compared with last year’s report. The report also highlights the importance of secure and diversified supply chains as renewables take on a larger role in energy systems worldwide. India is emerging as an important alternative source of supply, with its share of global solar PV module manufacturing expected to almost double to 17 per cent over the next five years, helping diversify a market that remains highly concentrated. As solar PV and wind continue to expand rapidly around the world, enhancing power system flexibility becomes critically important for energy security, offering new opportunities in the process. The highest priority is for countries to ensure investment in electricity grids keeps pace with the growth of renewable capacity. This should be complemented by reforms to speed up the connection of new renewable power installations to electricity networks. The amount of advanced-stage renewable energy and storage projects waiting for grid connections worldwide increased by 60 per cent over the past year to 3 000 GW, four times the wind and solar PV capacity connected to the grid last year. Meanwhile, the deployment of battery storage has been accelerating in many countries, offering an important way to increase the flexibility of electricity systems rapidly. Measures to enable electricity demand to become more flexible are equally important and can be implemented quickly. Digital technologies, including artificial intelligence, can help shift demand towards periods when renewable power supply is abundant, allowing a better use of variable renewable generation sources. Together, these measures will be crucial to ensuring that the rapid expansion of renewables translates into more secure, affordable and reliable energy supplies worldwide We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.title_zh: 国际能源署：新兴经济体成为可再生能源投资最大地区，中国除外
https://leadership.ng/emerging-economies.body_zh: 没有结果 查看全部结果 首页 新闻 政治 商业 体育 足球 健康 娱乐 教育 观点 社论 专栏 其他 LeVogue 杂志 会议 国家经济 联系我们 豪萨语版 首页 新闻 政治 商业 体育 足球 健康 娱乐 教育 观点 社论 专栏 其他 LeVogue 杂志 会议 国家经济 联系我们 没有结果 查看全部结果 没有结果 查看全部结果 Chika Izuora 7秒前 商业 国际能源署（IEA）就全球可再生能源的最新发展提供了新见解。数据显示，在霍尔木兹危机加剧各国对本土能源关注之际，中国以外新兴和发展中经济体的可再生能源装机增量首次预计将赶上发达经济体。IEA最新报告《可再生能源2026》是其关于该行业的年度旗舰报告。报告指出，可再生能源在当前能源危机爆发前已以创纪录速度扩张。随着各国政府寻求加强能源安全、减少对进口燃料和价格波动的依赖，未来几年可再生能源将在全球更多国家实现强劲增长。报告预计，2026年至2031年间，全球可再生能源发电装机容量将增加近4 800吉瓦（GW），比此前六年的增量高出近60%。到2031年，太阳能光伏将贡献全球可再生能源装机增量的四分之三以上，其次是陆上风电。自2月底伊朗战争爆发以来，全球能源市场遭遇空前中断。在更强政策支持和日益加剧的能源安全担忧推动下，印度、东南亚、非洲和中东正在更快部署可再生能源发电。预测期内，中国以外新兴和发展中经济体新增的可再生能源发电装机容量将首次预计与发达经济体新增装机量相当。随着其可再生能源政策发生变化，中国仍将是全球可再生能源发电装机增量最大的贡献国，但其占比预计将从2025年的60%以上降至预测期内的平均53%。印度正成为全球第二大可再生能源增长市场，到2031年其可再生能源总装机容量预计将增至两倍以上。东南亚、中东和北非以及撒哈拉以南非洲的装机增长也正在加快。报告预测，这些地区2026年至2031年间新增的可再生能源装机容量将接近此前六年的三倍。IEA执行主任Fatih Birol表示：“过去，环境担忧是推动可再生能源增长的政策优先事项，而不断下降的成本已使其在许多市场成为具有竞争力的选择。但如今，推动可再生能源扩张的主要因素是能源安全，越来越多国家希望减少对进口燃料的依赖。可再生能源增长故事正在开启真正全球化的新篇章，其应用正从主要市场延伸到世界每个角落。这正使可再生能源成为全球电力行业的支柱。如今，可再生能源占全球发电量的三分之一；未来五年，其占比将接近一半。”可再生能源发电新增装机的增长不仅来自公用事业公司和开发商的大型项目，也直接受到许多国家消费者的推动。面对一些市场燃料价格高企和供电不稳定的情况，全球家庭和小型企业正越来越多地转向价格更实惠、能够快速安装的屋顶太阳能光伏系统。报告发现，这些小规模安装项目已帮助全球约7 000万户家庭改善了电力服务。报告预测，到2031年，交通领域可再生能源使用量将增长60%以上，届时将满足全球交通行业能源需求的6%。电动车使用的可再生电力约贡献这一增量的45%，生物燃料则是第二大贡献来源。为应对燃料价格高企和供应方面的挑战，多个国家，尤其是东南亚和拉丁美洲国家，提高了强制掺混比例要求，规定加油站销售的汽油或柴油中必须掺入的生物燃料最低比例。我们对生物燃料的预测较去年的报告上调了40%。报告还强调，随着可再生能源在全球能源系统中承担更大角色，安全且多元化的供应链至关重要。印度正成为重要的替代供应来源，未来五年其在全球太阳能光伏组件制造中的份额预计将接近翻倍，达到17%，有助于推动这个仍高度集中的市场实现多元化。随着太阳能光伏和风电在全球各地继续快速扩张，提高电力系统灵活性对能源安全变得至关重要，同时也带来了新的机遇。各国当前的首要任务是确保电网投资跟上可再生能源装机容量的增长。还应通过改革，加快新可再生能源发电项目接入电网。全球等待并网的后期可再生能源及储能项目规模过去一年增长了60%，达到3 000吉瓦（GW），是去年并网风电和太阳能光伏装机的四倍。与此同时，许多国家正加速部署电池储能，为快速提高电力系统灵活性提供重要途径。使电力需求变得更灵活的举措同样重要，而且可以迅速实施。包括人工智能在内的数字技术可以将用电需求转移到可再生能源供应充足的时段，从而更充分地利用出力可变的可再生能源。这些措施将共同确保可再生能源的快速扩张转化为全球更安全、更实惠且更可靠的能源供应。我们掌握独家优势。立即将实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时随地获取24/7更新 →

MANILA, Philippines – A United States envoy dismissed reports on Saturday, November 7, that a framework agreement for the US-backed Pax Silica Economic Security Zone would be signed during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in Manila this month. “No such announcement on the Pax Silica Economic Security Zone was ever planned. Decisions will be made in full consultation with the government of the Philippines at the appropriate time,” US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton said in a statement. US President Donald Trump will be among the global leaders expected to attend the regional event. Envisioned as a massive 1,620-hectare industrial hub in New Clark City, Capas, Tarlac, the Pax Silica development is estimated by the BCDA to attract up to US$70 billion in investments and create as many as 190,000 direct jobs. The project, however, faces mounting criticisms in the Philippines, with many noting that the hub could harm the country’s environment, displace indigenous communities, and strain the Luzon energy grid because of its massive power and water needs, among others. “We look forward to working alongside the government of the Philippines about this exciting initiative to secure supply chains and attract quality investment in support of economic growth and jobs at home for the people,” Lipton said. – Rappler.com Upgrade to Rappler+ for exclusive content and unlimited access

https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.title: Why Beijing wants us to go quiet
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.summary: Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea. And now there are voices here saying perhaps we should oblige, perhaps transparency has done its job, perhaps it is time to be quiet for the sake of good relations. Before we go down that road, we should ask a simple question: Why does China want us quiet, and who benefits if we are?
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.summary_zh: 北京刚刚要求我国政府压制自己的民众，尤其是那些向公众展示西菲律宾海发生了什么的人。如今，国内又有人声称，也许我们应当照办，也许透明度已经完成了自己的使命，也许为了保持良好关系，是时候保持沉默。在我们走上这条道路之前，应当提出一个简单的问题：中国为什么希望我们保持沉默？如果我们保持沉默，谁将从中受益？
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.body: That sounds good. Nobody in the Philippine government is against keeping an open line of communication with China. But I read the other side’s version, too, and I suggest every Filipino do the same. In Xinhua’s account, Wang told Lazaro that relations are suffering from malicious interference by a small number of Filipino politicians who keep attacking China and crossing its red lines. He asked Manila to tighten its oversight of the individuals concerned and speak with one rational, unified voice on China. So let us not pretend this was only about lowering the temperature. Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea. And now there are voices here saying perhaps we should oblige, perhaps transparency has done its job, perhaps it is time to be quiet for the sake of good relations. Before we go down that road, we should ask a simple question: Why does China want us quiet, and who benefits if we are? I have been part of this since the beginning, so let me explain what transparency actually did. Before 2023, what happened at sea stayed at sea. The China Coast Guard would block us, ram us and hit us with water cannons, and the public would find out, if at all, through a diplomatic note filed weeks later. Beijing’s denial would come out the same afternoon. We began releasing videos, photographs, the exact time and location of each incident, and the legal basis for Philippine presence and jurisdiction, usually within hours. The water cannon attacks at Bajo de Masinloc. The military-grade laser pointed at our crew. The ramming of resupply boats at Ayungin. The swarming of vessels in our exclusive economic zone. All of it is now on the record, documented not only by Filipinos who were there with us but also by independent foreign journalists who witnessed these incidents firsthand. Yes, we deliberately leveraged one of our most cherished democratic values — freedom of the press — to help us tell the world the truth. China can still deny what happened, but it must now contend with photographic and video evidence. In the past, Beijing could more easily control the narrative, using malign influence operations to shape domestic and international public opinion. Our transparency initiative has fundamentally changed that dynamic, severely constraining China’s ability to manipulate information and distort the facts. Anyone working in defense or foreign policy who fails to understand these dynamics and their implications for long-term Philippine interests is neglecting a fundamental responsibility. Here is the first thing China gains if we go quiet: The world goes quiet with us. When Washington, Tokyo, Canberra, Ottawa, Brussels or the G7 condemn the actions of the China Coast Guard in our waters, they are not reacting to our news conferences. They are reacting to the footage we release. A foreign minister can issue a statement of concern based on compelling video evidence. No government issues such a statement based on rumors, much less on a confidential note verbale or diplomatic démarche delivered weeks after the incident. The same footage helps sustain the security partnerships we have built. Every like-minded government has to explain to its own parliament and people why it signs a maritime cooperation agreement with Manila, why its coast guard sails with ours and why it helps support our modernization. The daily record of Chinese behavior in the West Philippine Sea is their justification. Take it away, and supporting the Philippines becomes an abstraction. Abstractions do not survive a budget hearing. Beijing knows this. I am not sure all of our own officials do. When dealing with an actor that has lied many times and fooled us on numerous occasions, silence does not buy us greater diplomatic space. It simply takes us back to how things were before 2023, when China kept pushing the envelope and we filed diplomatic protests whose full contents nobody ever saw. China has learned from our last two elections that being seen as close to Beijing is now a liability in Philippine politics. Candidates who once proudly boasted of their friendship with China now prefer to change the subject. It is difficult to campaign on the claim that China is our friend when voters can see, on their own phones, Chinese Coast Guard vessels firing water cannons at Philippine Coast Guard ships, threatening Filipino fishermen and depriving them of their livelihoods. Beijing’s answer to that problem is not to change how it behaves at sea. It is to make sure nobody sees it anymore. If transparency ends in 2027, the West Philippine Sea is out of the news by 2028. People forget. The field is then wide open for politicians who owe Beijing, backed by Beijing’s money, to take back Malacañang and put the next president on a leash for six years. It is about who sits in the Palace after 2028 and whether that person answers to the Filipino people or to someone else. One last detail from this week, because it tells you everything about who we are dealing with. Our DFA says Secretary Lazaro received the call from Wang. Xinhua says Wang took the call at Lazaro’s request. China’s malign influence operators got to work and reinforced this messaging to make the Philippines appear desperate. The Chinese term they used, 应约, is the formula Beijing uses when the other side asked for the conversation. In other words, the two governments cannot agree on who picked up the phone first. In December 2023, Beijing said then-Secretary Manalo had requested his call with Wang. Diplomatic sources in Manila insisted it was the Chinese side that called. Twice now, on the most trivial of things in diplomacy, China has told the world a different story from the one it told us. Both times, the story made the Philippines look like the one coming to Beijing, hat in hand, to patch things up. And this latest one came barely two weeks after their ambassador reminded us that China could easily win if it chose to use force. And now Beijing is asking us to trust its good faith and stop documenting what its ships do in our own waters. If China is willing to rewrite the record of a phone call, what would stop it from doing the same with a water cannon attack, a ramming incident or the next confrontation at Bajo de Masinloc or Ayungin? Without footage from our side, Beijing would be free to push its version of events, with little evidence available to challenge it. Diplomacy with China remains necessary, but it must never come at the expense of documenting what happens in our waters. Footage provides evidence that Beijing cannot simply dismiss or explain away. A country that cannot be honest about who dialed cannot be trusted to be honest about anything that matters more. Your subscription could not be saved. Please try again. Your subscription has been successful. He holds a doctoral degree from the National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS) in Tokyo and a master’s degree jointly awarded by GRIPS and the Japan Coast Guard Academy.) https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.title_zh: 北京为何希望我们保持沉默
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.body_zh: 听起来不错。菲律宾政府中没有人反对同中国保持公开的沟通渠道。但我也读了对方的说法，并建议每一位菲律宾人都这么做。在新华社的报道中，王表示，菲中关系正受到少数菲律宾政治分子的恶意干扰；他们不断攻击中国，并越过中国的红线。他要求马尼拉加强对相关人员的监督，并以理性、统一的立场对华发声。因此，我们不要假装这只是为了降温。北京只是要求我国政府封住本国人的嘴，尤其是那些向公众展示西菲律宾海实际情况的人。现在，这里甚至有人认为，也许我们应当照办，也许透明度已经完成了自己的使命，也许为了良好关系，现在该保持沉默了。在我们走上这条路之前，应该提出一个简单的问题：中国为什么希望我们保持沉默，而我们保持沉默又将使谁受益？我从一开始就参与其中，所以让我解释透明度究竟发挥了什么作用。在2023年以前，海上发生的事只留在海上。中国海警会阻挡我们、冲撞我们并用水炮袭击我们，而公众即使最终得知此事，也只能通过数周后提交的外交照会。新华社的报道版本也是如此。我们开始发布视频、照片、每起事件发生的准确时间和地点，以及菲律宾存在和管辖权的法律依据，通常在数小时内公布。对巴焦德马辛洛克水炮袭击的记录。针对我们船员照射的军用激光。对阿永金岛补给船的冲撞。在我国专属经济区聚集船只。如今，这一切都已记录在案，不仅有与我们同在现场菲律宾人的记录，还有独立外国记者对这些事件的第一手见证。是的，我们有意利用了一项最珍视的民主价值——新闻自由——帮助我们向世界讲述真相。中国仍能否认发生过的事情，但现在它必须面对照片和视频证据。过去，北京更容易控制叙事，利用恶意影响行动塑造国内外公众舆论。我们的透明度倡议从根本上改变了这种态势，严重限制了中國操纵信息和歪曲事实的能力。任何从事国防或外交工作的人，如果不能理解这些态势及其对菲律宾长期利益的影响，就是在逃避一项基本责任。如果我们保持沉默，中国首先得到的好处就是：世界也会随我们一同沉默。当华盛顿、东京、堪培拉、渥太华、布鲁塞尔或七国集团谴责中国海警在我国水域的行动时，他们回应的是我们公布的影像，而不是我们的新闻发布会。外交部长可以依据有力的视频证据发表关切声明。没有哪个政府会依据传闻发表这样的声明，更不会依据事件数周后才提交的秘密照会或外交交涉。同一批影像也有助于维持我们建立的安全伙伴关系。每一个持相同立场的政府，都必须向本国议会和民众解释：为什么与马尼拉签署海上合作协议，为什么其海警与我国海警共同航行，以及为什么支持我国的现代化。中国在西菲律宾海的日常行为记录就是这些解释的依据。一旦拿走这些记录，支持菲律宾就会变成一种抽象概念。抽象概念无法通过预算听证会。北京知道这一点。我不确定我们所有官员都知道。面对一个多次说谎、多次欺骗我们的行为体，沉默不会为我们争取更多外交空间，只会把我们带回2023年以前的状态：那时中国不断试探边界，而我们提交的外交抗议，其完整内容从未有人看到。中国已经从我们最近两次选举中吸取教训：如今，在菲律宾政治中，被视为与北京关系密切已是一项负担。过去曾自豪炫耀与中国友好关系的候选人，如今更愿意转移话题。当选民能在自己的手机上看到中国海警船只向菲律宾海警船只发射水炮、威胁菲律宾渔民并夺走他们的生计时，很难再以“中国是我们的朋友”为竞选主张。北京对这一问题的回答，不是改变其在海上的行为，而是确保再也没有人看到。如果透明度在2027年终结，到2028年，西菲律宾海就会从新闻中消失。人们会忘记。到那时，受北京资助、欠北京人情的政客便可以毫无阻碍地重新夺回马拉卡尼昂宫，并让下一任总统在六年内受其牵制。问题在于2028年后谁将入住总统府，以及那个人效忠于菲律宾人民，还是另一个人。本周还有一个细节，因为它能说明我们面对的是怎样的人。我们的外交部表示，秘书长拉扎罗接听了王的电话。新华社则称，王应拉扎罗的请求接听电话。中国的恶意影响操盘手随即展开工作，强化这一说法，让菲律宾显得迫不及待。他们使用的中文词“应约”，是北京在对方请求会谈时使用的表述。换言之，两国政府甚至无法就谁先拨通电话达成一致。2023年12月，北京称时任部长马纳洛要求与王通话；马尼拉的外交消息人士则坚称，是中方打来的。外交中最琐碎的事情，中国已经两次向世界讲述了与我们所听不同的版本。两次，这种说法都让菲律宾显得像是主动向北京低头，希望修补关系。而最新一次说法出现前不到两周，其大使还提醒我们，如果中国愿意使用武力，就能轻易获胜。如今，北京却要求我们信任它的善意，并停止记录其船只在我国水域的行为。如果中国连谁拨通电话都愿意改写，它还有什么理由不会对水炮袭击、冲撞事件，或巴焦德马辛洛克和阿永金岛的下一轮对抗做同样的事？如果没有我方影像，北京就能自由推送其事件版本，而几乎没有证据可供质疑。与中国开展外交仍然必要，但绝不能以牺牲记录我国水域所发生之事的透明度为代价。影像提供了北京无法轻易否认或搪塞的证据。一个连谁拨通电话都不肯诚实相告的国家，在更重大的事情上也无法被信任为诚实。你的订阅未能保存。请重试。你的订阅已成功。（Jay Tristan Tarriela海军少将、博士，指挥西菲律宾海透明度小组，并担任菲律宾海警在西菲律宾海事务上的发言人。他拥有东京国家政策研究大学院（GRIPS）授予的博士学位，以及由GRIPS和日本海岸警卫队学院联合授予的硕士学位。）如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海动态专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点持续了解最新情况。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/s.title: Spain’s Puente And Africa’s Elusive ‘Political Dignity’
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/s.summary: Oscar Puente, Spain’s Minister of Transport, was largely unknown outside his home country until a little over a week ago. Puente’s act, which he described as being done for the sake of “political dignity,” is worthy of emulation. This is why “political dignity” remains so elusive on our continent.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/s.summary_zh: 西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特直到一周多前，在本国以外仍几乎不为人知。普恩特表示，他的行动是出于“政治尊严”，这一做法值得效仿。这也正是“政治尊严”在我们这片大陆上依然如此难以实现的原因。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/s.body: Oscar Puente, Spain’s Minister of Transport, was largely unknown outside his home country until a little over a week ago. He came into the international limelight after at least 69 people died and dozens more were injured in a high-speed train collision in his country. He was not the driver of the train, nor has it been officially established that he was negligent in the accident. But six days after the collision, he took responsibility as the man in charge of the ministry and voluntarily resigned. At his appearance before his country’s Congress to give evidence about last week’s disaster near the town of Adamuz, south of the capital, Madrid, where a moving train smashed into the back of a stationary train, he announced his decision to resign. That collision involved a train run by the state-owned operator Renfe, with 397 passengers on board, and a stationary train run by a private operator named Iryo that was carrying 147 passengers. The accident reportedly stemmed from an issue with the automatic signalling system, a computer failure that forced all trains to halt on the affected stretch. Another appointee seeking to evade responsibility would have blamed unforeseen technical glitches beyond human control. He did not just resign; he stated that he was also withdrawing his name from “the lists for the early legislative elections” scheduled for November 29. Sadly, Spain’s train crash last week was described as one of the worst rail disasters in modern European history, and the country’s worst since 2013. Rescue operations deployed heavy lifting equipment to access derailed carriages where passengers were trapped. No wonder Puente’s position came under immediate scrutiny after the crash. The main conservative opposition People’s Party (PP) and the far-right Vox party called for his resignation. Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez admitted that public trust in the credibility of the high-speed rail system had been “broken.” But Puente resigned because he wanted to, not because of any opposition pressure, which is particularly dignified considering the incident’s closeness to an imminent election. Puente’s act, which he described as being done for the sake of “political dignity,” is worthy of emulation. Prime Minister Sánchez was proud of him when he said that he “faced up to the situation, provided answers and solutions, and then stepped aside… out of dignity. Of his own accord. Out of respect for the victims.” When juxtaposed with the public service attitude across the Black man’s continent, political office is largely misconstrued as a personal reward rather than a public trust. When disaster strikes, when a grid collapses, or when a flood that was clearly made worse by years of neglected drainage occurs, the routine response from the appointees in charge is not resignation, but inexcusable explanations. Such an appointee’s responsibility is diffused until it is effaced by time, since our people are believed to have a short institutional memory. Usually, on our continent, when disasters or accidents happen, condolences are issued, a committee is set up, and the minister or other such appointees remain in office to supervise the committee investigating their own ministry or agency. The reports of such committees are submitted only to gather dust on shelves in offices, like in the instance of the latest report of the inquiry into the deaths of miners in Niger State while in the custody of the civil defence corps. No one will eventually be sanctioned for treating the lives of (illegal) miners so shabbily. Even the current Minister of Education, Dr Tunji Alausa, sometime ago reportedly confessed in the media that NECO examination papers leaked, with no heads rolling, voluntarily or otherwise, for the poor handling of such examination papers. This is why “political dignity” remains so elusive on our continent. Even in clear instances of underperformance, appointees in our clime find it difficult to resign voluntarily from their appointments. This administration, and even the one before it, have had to send some ministers packing. Examples abound, including Prof. Tahir Mamman, former Minister of Education, who was dismissed by President Bola Tinubu on October 23, 2024, for underperformance. Barrister Uju Kennedy-Ohanenye, then Minister of Women Affairs, was removed on October 23, 2024, because her tenure was marred by avoidable altercations that hampered the ministry’s operations. Also, Lola Ade-John, former Minister of Tourism, was relieved of her position due to poor performance. The same applied to Dr. Jamila Bio Ibrahim, former Minister of Youth Development. Both were relieved of their duties on October 23, 2024. In addition, Betta Edu, the Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Alleviation under this administration, was suspended in January 2024 following public outcry over a controversial transfer of ₦585 million into a private account. She failed to resign voluntarily before she was suspended, after which her position was filled. Adebayo Adelabu, former Minister of Power, despite severe criticism for repeated collapses of the national electricity grid and chronic power outages, stayed put in office until the electoral timeline for political party primaries compelled his departure. The head of the previous administration, former President Muhammadu Buhari, sacked Sabo Nanono, his Minister of Agriculture, and Saleh Mamman, Minister of Power, on the same day in September 2021 for failing to meet the operational expectations of his administration. Despite glaring signals that they were performing below par, the aforementioned appointees failed to throw in the towel voluntarily. Under the same Buhari administration, Adamu Adamu, the Minister of Education, served out the tenure of that government despite his inept handling of protracted strikes by the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU) that paralysed the tertiary education system. His subsequent confession at the end of his tenure that he knew nothing about education-sector management and had refused to resign confirmed the alien nature of voluntary resignation among political appointees in this part of the world. However, Puente could voluntarily resign because, in Spain, the system allowed him to. His prime minister could accept his resignation without it looking like a confession of guilt for the entire government, while a credible press of that country treated the victims as more important than the minister’s political future. No cover-up. Resignation under such institutional circumstances should be understood for what it is: it should not be seen as a criminal admission but as an acceptance of political responsibility. On our continent, including in Nigeria, these conditions barely exist because loyalty is largely personal with no iota of consideration for institutional sanctity. A minister on our continent owes their appointment to a political godfather or a president, not to the public. To resign voluntarily is therefore read as disloyalty or betrayal, and most of the time with serious communal consequences for toeing the path of honour. So, clinging to office is perceived as a form of self-defence. For example, Hope Uzodimma, incumbent governor of Imo state, and others perceive the National Assembly as a retirement home because there are no institutional checks for overstaying in power even without commensurate achievements. The only consequence is that the public is temporarily outraged, while the opposition remains largely disunited and institutional pressure remains persistently weak due to corruption and affinity for impunity. Men like Puente are in short supply on the African continent, and the few available ones are always afraid to act for the sake of institutional growth because our system punishes honour and rewards graft. The bar of public service overseas is high but not because the whites are from a different planet. The Europeans who colonised and committed the worst atrocities against Black people and mankind are not more moral than we are. It is just that their culture promotes political dignity and a political culture that largely embodies institutional dignity. In their clime, public office is seen as stewardship, where the parliament actually checks power, the judiciary truly resolves conflicts impartially, and stepping aside out of respect for victims is understood as strength, not a weakness. Such resignations on our continent should be made normal by developing a political culture that makes loyalty to the public outweigh loyalty to the appointing authority. As rightly pointed out by the 26th President of the United States, Theodore Roosevelt, attaining a sound body politic requires “public integrity… and personal dignity.” And despite the riotous political quagmire that Roosevelt’s country is currently experiencing under President Donald Trump, there are inbuilt institutional checks to correct such. Until we separate political responsibility from criminal guilt on our continent as well, we will continue to watch from afar as others show us what “I take responsibility” truly means. I hereby rest my case for this week. •Sanusi, former MD/CEO of the Lagos State Signage and Advertisement Agency, is currently Managing Partner at AMS RELIABLE SOLICITORS. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/s.title_zh: 西班牙的普恩特与非洲 elusive 的“政治尊严”
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/s.body_zh: 西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特在本国之外几乎无人知晓，直到一周多以前才广受国际关注。原因是他的国家发生高速列车相撞事故，至少69人死亡，另有数十人受伤。他既不是列车司机，事故发生后也尚未被官方认定存在失职行为。然而，在事故发生6天后，他以主管该部门的负责人身份承担责任，自愿辞职。他到本国国会就上周发生在首都马德里南部阿达穆兹镇附近的灾难作证时，宣布了辞职决定。当时，一列行驶中的列车撞上静止列车的尾部。事故涉及一列由国有运营商Renfe运营的列车，车上有397名乘客；另一列由名为Iryo的私人运营商运营的静止列车上载有147名乘客。据报道，事故源于自动信号系统出现问题，这是一起计算机故障，迫使受影响区段的所有列车停运。另一位试图逃避责任的任命者本可以把事故归咎于人类无法控制的突发技术故障。但普恩特不仅辞职，还宣布把自己的名字从定于11月29日举行的“提前议会选举”候选名单中撤下。遗憾的是，上周西班牙的列车相撞事故被称为现代欧洲历史上最严重的铁路灾难之一，也是该国自2013年以来最严重的一次。救援行动调动了重型起吊设备，以便接近脱轨车厢，营救被困乘客。难怪事故发生后，普恩特的职位立即受到审查。主流保守派反对党人民党（PP）和极右翼Vox党均要求他辞职。社会主义者首相佩德罗·桑切斯承认，公众对高速铁路系统可信度的信任已经“遭到破坏”。但普恩特辞职是因为他想辞职，而不是因为反对派的压力。考虑到这起事件临近即将举行的选举，他尤其显得有尊严。普恩特称此举是出于“政治尊严”，值得效仿。桑切斯首相在提到他时感到自豪，说他“正视局面、提供了答案和解决方案，然后退下……是出于尊严。自愿退下。出于对受害者的尊重。”与非洲黑人大陆各地的公共服务态度相比，政治职位在很大程度上被误解为个人奖赏，而非公众信托。灾难发生、电网崩溃，或明显因多年疏于维护排水系统而加剧的洪水来袭时，负责的任命者惯常的反应不是辞职，而是给出不可原谅的辩解。这类任命者的责任会被推卸，直至随着时间推移而消失，因为人们认为我们的人民制度记忆短暂。通常，在我们的大陆，灾难或事故发生后，人们会发表慰问，设立委员会，而部长或其他任命者仍留任，监督调查本部门或本机构的委员会。这类委员会的报告最终只会提交后在办公室的架子上积灰，就像最新一份关于尼日尔州民防队拘押期间矿工死亡事件的调查报告一样。终究不会有人因如此草率对待（非法）矿工的生命而受到制裁。现任教育部长图恩吉·阿劳萨博士不久前据称还在媒体上承认，NECO考试试卷泄露，但此事处理不善，却没有人被追究责任，无论自愿还是其他方式。这就是“政治尊严”在我们大陆依然如此难以企及的原因。即使在绩效明显不佳的情况下，我们这里的任命者仍很难主动辞去所任职务。本届政府，甚至上一届政府，都不得不让一些部长卷铺盖走人。例子比比皆是，包括前教育部长 tahir·马曼教授，他因绩效不佳于2024年10月23日被博拉·蒂努布总统解职。当时担任妇女事务部长的律师乌朱·肯尼迪-奥哈内耶，也于2024年10月23日被免职，因为她在任期间发生了本可避免的争执，妨碍了部门工作。前旅游部长洛拉·阿德-约翰同样因表现不佳而被解除职务。前青年发展部长贾米拉·比奥·易卜拉欣博士也面临同样情况。两人均于2024年10月23日被免职。此外，本届政府的人道主义事务与减贫部长贝塔·埃杜因将5.85亿奈拉转移至私人账户，引发公众强烈抗议，于2024年1月遭停职。她在被停职前没有主动辞职，之后其职位由他人接任。前电力部长阿德巴约·阿德拉巴尽管因全国电网反复崩溃和长期停电而遭到严厉批评，却仍稳坐职位，直到政党初选的时间表迫使他离开。上一届政府领导人、前总统穆罕马杜·布希里于2021年9月同日解职了农业部长萨博·纳诺诺和电力部长萨勒赫·马曼，原因是他们未能达到政府的工作预期。尽管明显有迹象显示这些任命者表现不佳，上述人员仍没有主动认输退出。在布希里政府任内，教育部长阿达穆·阿达穆尽管对大学学术人员工会（ASUU）长期罢工处理无能，导致高等教育体系陷入瘫痪，却仍任满本届政府任期。他在任期结束时承认自己根本不懂教育部门的管理，而且拒绝辞职，这进一步证实了自愿辞职在世界各地政治任命者中是何等陌生。然而，普恩特之所以能够自愿辞职，是因为在西班牙，制度允许他这样做。他的首相可以接受他的辞职，而不会显得像是整个政府认罪；同时，该国可信的媒体把受害者置于部长政治前途之上。没有任何掩盖。在这样的制度环境下，辞职应当被正确理解：不应被视为犯罪层面的供认，而应被视为接受政治责任。在我们的大陆，包括在尼日利亚，这些条件几乎不存在，因为忠诚在很大程度上是个人化的，毫无对制度神圣性的考量。我们大陆的部长之所以获得任命，靠的是政治靠山或总统，而非公众。因此，自愿辞职往往被解读为不忠或背叛，而且多数时候，选择走荣誉之路还会招致严重的社群后果。所以，死守职位被视为一种自我防卫。例如，伊莫州现任州长霍普·乌佐迪马等人把国民议会视为退休之家，因为即便没有相应政绩，也没有任何制度性制约来阻止他们继续掌权。唯一的后果是公众暂时愤怒，而反对派依然大体分裂，制度压力也因腐败和庇护 impunity的倾向而持续薄弱。普恩特这样的人在非洲大陆寥寥无几，而少数存在的人又总是害怕为制度发展而行动，因为我们的制度惩罚荣誉、奖励贪腐。海外公共服务的标准很高，但这并不是因为白人来自另一个星球。那些殖民并对黑人和全人类犯下最严重暴行的欧洲人，并不比我们更有道德。只是他们的文化 promotes 政治尊严，也形成了大体体现制度尊严的政治文化。在他们的地方，公职被视为一种受托责任：议会确实制约权力，司法部门真正公正地解决冲突，出于对受害者的尊重而退下，被视为力量而非软弱。我们大陆也应当通过培育一种政治文化，使忠于公众重于忠于任命者，从而让这类辞职成为常态。正如美国第26任总统西奥多·罗斯福正确指出的那样，实现健全的政体需要“公共诚信……以及个人尊严。”尽管罗斯福的国家目前正在唐纳德·特朗普总统治下陷入喧闹的政治泥潭，但那里存在内置的制度制衡，能够纠正此类问题。除非我们大陆也能把政治责任与犯罪责任区分开来，否则我们还将继续远远地看着别人 demonstrating“我承担责任”的真正含义。本周我就此结束论证。•桑努西曾任拉各斯州标识与广告局董事总经理，现任AMS RELIABLE SOLICITORS管理合伙人。（仅限WhatsApp：07011117777）THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/e.summary_zh: 订阅即可解锁这些内容。国会领袖拉胡尔·甘地于2026年11月7日（星期六）抨击莫迪政府推行E20汽油，并援引卡纳塔克邦政府采集样本的检测结果，要求中央政府就全国销售的燃油中乙醇的实际含量作出明确说明。
https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/e.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Saturday (November 7, 2026) attacked the Modi government over the rollout of E20 petrol , citing test results of samples collected by the Karnataka government, and asked the Centre to come clean on the actual ethanol content in fuel being sold across the country. In a post in Hindi on X, Mr. Gandhi said, “E20 turned into 420 – stealing petrol from the public's cars!” The reference was to Section 420 of the erstwhile Indian Penal Code, which dealt with cheating. Mr. Gandhi said the government claims that petrol contains 20% ethanol, but tests conducted on samples collected from seven districts in Karnataka had revealed higher levels. “The Karnataka government collected petrol samples from 7 districts and had them tested at an accredited lab. Look at the results — 11 out of 14 samples contained more than 20% ethanol; 31.2% at IOCL, 30.5% at HPCL; IOCL, HPCL, BPCL, Nayara, Shell, whether government-owned or private — all exceeded the limit,” he claimed. He also alleged that the companies’ own laboratories had not reported the ethanol content. Mr. Gandhi claimed that excessive ethanol blending could affect vehicle performance, resulting in lower mileage and higher maintenance costs. He also questioned the absence of labels at fuel stations disclosing the ethanol content of petrol. “Modi ji, tell us — what's being put in the country's tank? How much ethanol is actually in the petrol? When will action be taken against companies mixing more than 20% ethanol?” he said. Mr. Gandhi also reiterated his challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for an open debate, saying the issue of ethanol blending could be included in the discussion. His remarks came a day after the Karnataka government alleged that major oil marketing companies (OMCs) were supplying petrol with ethanol content exceeding the prescribed 20% limit, with tests recording levels as high as 31.2%. It had sought action against the companies. Addressing a press conference, Karnataka Food, Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs and Legal Metrology Minister Rizwan Arshad said the allegations were based on tests conducted on samples collected from Bengaluru, Kolar, Chikkaballapura, Bengaluru Rural, Ramanagara, Mangaluru and Tumakuru. According to test results issued by the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories-accredited and ISO-certified Shriram Research Institute in Bengaluru, samples from Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) recorded ethanol content of 31.2% and 30.5%, respectively. The Minister said samples collected from major fuel companies had revealed ethanol content exceeding 20%. However, State-run OMCs Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), Bharat Petroleum Corporation (BPCL) and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation (HPCL) have disputed the Karnataka government's claims, questioning the sampling and testing procedures used to arrive at the findings. The three companies said E20 petrol supplied across their retail networks, including in Karnataka, conforms to the Bureau of Indian Standards’ IS 17021 specifications, which prescribe an ethanol content of 19-21%. In a joint statement, the companies said the findings cited by the Karnataka government were not supported by tests conducted in accordance with prescribed statutory and technical procedures. They also questioned the use of third-party laboratory certificates, saying these did not disclose sufficient details of the testing methodology to independently verify the reported ethanol levels. India’s ethanol-blending programme, which began with a pilot initiative in 2001, aims to reduce dependence on imported crude oil, strengthen domestic agricultural value chains and improve energy security. The programme has been expanded through successive policy interventions, including the National Policy on Biofuels, 2018, and the NITI Aayog roadmap for ethanol blending. During the 2025-26 ethanol supply year, which ended on October 31, 2026, the three public sector OMCs procured 1,089 crore litres of ethanol and blended 1,134 crore litres against petrol sales of approximately 5,673 crore litres. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/e.body_zh: 订阅可享受《国会》领导层 Rahul Gandhi 于星期六（2026年11月7日）就推行 E20 汽油抨击 Modi 政府的相关报道，以及《深度报道》《社论》《观点》等更多内容。与《国会》领导层 Rahul Gandhi 一起解锁这些内容。Rahul Gandhi 在 X 平台上用印地语发文称， Modi 政府在推广 E20 汽油的问题上窃取公众利益，并援引卡纳塔克邦政府采集样本的检测结果，要求中央政府就全国销售的燃料中实际乙醇含量作出明确说明。Gandhi 先生写道：“E20 变成了 420——这是从公众的汽车里偷汽油！”这里指的是原《印度刑法典》第 420 条，该条涉及欺诈行为。Gandhi 先生称，政府声称汽油含有 20% 的乙醇，但卡纳塔克邦 7 个地区采集样本的检测结果显示乙醇含量更高。他声称：“卡纳塔克邦政府从 7 个地区采集了汽油样本，并将其送至经认可实验室进行检测。请看结果——14 个样本中有 11 个含有超过 20% 的乙醇；IOCL 为 31.2%，HPCL 为 30.5%；IOCL、HPCL、BPCL、Nayara、Shell，无论政府所有还是私营，全都超过了限值。”他还指称，这些公司自己的实验室并未报告乙醇含量。Gandhi 先生称，过量掺混乙醇可能影响车辆性能，导致油耗降低、维护成本上升。他还质疑加油站没有标注汽油中乙醇含量的问题。他说：“Modi ji，请告诉我们——国家的油箱里到底加入了什么？汽油中实际上有多少乙醇？什么时候才会对掺入超过 20% 乙醇的公司采取行动？”Gandhi 先生还再次要求与总理 Narendra Modi 公开辩论，并表示可以将乙醇掺混问题纳入讨论。上述言论发布前一天，卡纳塔克邦政府指称大型石油营销公司（OMCs）供应的汽油乙醇含量超过规定的 20% 限值，检测记录的乙醇含量最高达到 31.2%，并要求对这些公司采取行动。卡纳塔克邦食品、民事供应、消费者事务和计量部长 Rizwan Arshad 在新闻发布会上表示，这些指控基于对班加罗尔、科拉尔、奇克kaballapura、班加罗尔乡村、拉马纳agara、芒加洛尔和图马库采集样本的检测结果。根据位于班加罗尔、获得国家检测与校准实验室认可委员会认可并通过 ISO 认证的 Shriram Research Institute 发布的检测结果，Indian Oil Corporation Limited（IOCL）和 Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited（HPCL）的样本乙醇含量分别为 31.2% 和 30.5%。部长表示，从大型燃料公司采集的样本显示乙醇含量超过 20%。然而，国有 OMCs——Indian Oil Corporation（IOC）、Bharat Petroleum Corporation（BPCL）和 Hindustan Petroleum Corporation（HPCL）——对卡纳塔克邦政府的说法提出异议，质疑得出检测结果所采用的采样和检测程序。这三家公司表示，包括卡纳塔克邦在内，其零售网络供应的 E20 汽油符合印度标准局的 IS 17021 规范，该规范规定乙醇含量为 19% 至 21%。三家公司在一份联合声明中表示，卡纳塔克邦政府所引用的检测结果没有得到按照法定和技术程序开展的检测支持。它们还质疑使用第三方实验室证明的做法，称这些证明没有披露足够的检测方法细节，因而无法独立核实所报告的乙醇含量。印度乙醇掺混计划始于 2001 年的一项试点倡议，旨在减少对进口原油的依赖、强化国内农业价值链并提高能源安全。通过一系列政策干预，该计划不断扩大，其中包括 2018 年《生物燃料国家政策》以及 NITI Aayog 乙醇掺混路线图。在截至 2026 年 10 月 31 日的 2025-26 年度乙醇供应期内，三家公共部门 OMCs 共采购了 10.89 亿升乙醇，并在约 567.3 亿升汽油销量中掺混了 11.34 亿升乙醇。评论必须使用英语，并且必须是完整句子。评论不得含有辱骂性或人身攻击性内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章互动。如果你还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录账户后可以访问以前在 Vuukle 上发表的评论。

https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.title: Federal Govt Pushes Production-Driven Economy As Non-Oil Exports Hit $6.1bn
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.summary: The Minister of State for Industry, Trade and Investment, Senator John Enoh, who represented President Bola Tinubu at the opening of the 40th Lagos International Trade Fair, said Nigeria must prioritise production if it intends to compete effectively in the global economy.
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.summary_zh: 工业、贸易与投资部国务参议员 John Enoh 在第40届拉各斯国际贸易博览会开幕式上代表总统 Bola Tinubu 发表讲话。他表示，如果尼日利亚希望在全球经济中有效竞争，就必须优先发展生产。
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.body: The Minister of State for Industry, Trade and Investment, Senator John Enoh, who represented President Bola Tinubu at the opening of the 40th Lagos International Trade Fair, said Nigeria must prioritise production if it intends to compete effectively in the global economy. Enoh, who spoke at the event held yesterday, said the country must move beyond buying and selling to producing goods that can compete in international markets, noting that sustainable economic growth depends on domestic production, value addition and job creation. According to him, Nigeria must sell to the world to avoid being at the mercy of the world. He said, “Trade without production is merely buying and selling other people’s work. True growth will only come when we make things, add value and employ people at home.” The minister disclosed that non-oil exports exceeded $6.1 billion in 2025, while capital importation reached approximately $21 billion within the same period, describing the figures as evidence of renewed confidence in the Nigerian economy. He said the figures presented an opportunity for the country to consolidate its economic reforms and strengthen the productive sectors. Enoh recalled that when the Tinubu administration assumed office in May 2023, it inherited an economy facing significant challenges, including a distorted foreign exchange market, depleted external reserves, rising inflation and the burden of fuel subsidy payments. He, however, said the government had embarked on reforms to address the structural challenges and reposition the economy for sustainable growth. Providing an update on the economy, he said Nigeria’s gross external reserves stood at approximately $55.07 billion as of October 2026, while net reserves exceeded $40 billion. He added that headline inflation had declined from above 34 per cent at its peak to 14.63 per cent in September 2026, while the economy recorded a growth rate of 4.43 per cent in the second quarter of 2026. The minister said the economic indicators reinforced the need to build a production-driven economy capable of generating employment, increasing exports and attracting sustainable investments. He linked the objectives to the theme of the 40th Lagos International Trade Fair, ‘Trade, Growth and Global Connection’, noting that the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) offered Nigeria access to a market of approximately 1.4 billion people. However, he said the country must improve product standards, accelerate customs clearance procedures and remove unnecessary trade barriers to take full advantage of the continental market. Enoh also highlighted the Nigeria Industrial Policy, recently approved by the Federal Executive Council, as a strategic framework for strengthening manufacturing, deepening local value chains and transforming the country’s raw materials into finished products. He said effective implementation of the policy would help Nigerian businesses improve their competitiveness and increase the country’s share of international trade. Also speaking, Lagos State Governor, Mr Babajide Sanwo-Olu, said the 40th edition of the trade fair should provide opportunities for businesses to secure buyers, attract investments and strengthen supply chains. Sanwo-Olu, who was represented at the event, said Lagos was committed to positioning itself as a major manufacturing and commercial hub, urging businesses to increase production, processing and value addition. With more than 1,000 exhibitors expected from over 20 countries, he said the fair would provide a platform for businesses to establish partnerships and explore opportunities across regional and international markets. The governor cited Lagos State’s first-place ranking in the 2025 Presidential Enabling Business Environment Council (PEBEC) Subnational Ease of Doing Business Report, where it scored 85.6 per cent. He also highlighted the Lagos State Industrial Policy 2025-2030 and the Lagos State Export Readiness Programme, which has supported 253 small and medium-scale enterprises to prepare their products for international markets. According to him, many micro, small and medium enterprises in the state have the products and determination to compete globally but require access to finance, technology and larger markets to realise their potential. He urged exhibitors to take advantage of the fair’s business-to-business and business-to-government platforms to establish commercial relationships and attract the investments required to expand their operations. In his remarks, President of the Lagos Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LCCI), Engr. Leye Kupoluyi, said the trade fair had, over the past 40 years, played a significant role in connecting producers with consumers and facilitating business relationships across industries and international borders. Kupoluyi said the Chamber was focused on ensuring that participation in the fair translated into tangible commercial partnerships, business expansion and stronger enterprises. He noted that Nigerian businesses had demonstrated resilience and resourcefulness despite operating in a challenging environment. However, he stressed that businesses required reliable infrastructure, affordable financing, efficient logistics, improved security and predictable government policies to expand production and compete effectively in domestic and international markets. https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.title_zh: 联邦政府推动生产驱动型经济，非石油出口额达到61亿美元
https://leadership.ng/federal-govt-pushe.body_zh: 尼日利亚工业、贸易与投资国务部长、参议员John Enoh代表总统Bola Tinubu出席第40届拉各斯国际贸易博览会开幕式时表示，如果尼日利亚想在全球经济中有效竞争，就必须优先发展生产。Enoh昨天在活动上表示，该国必须超越单纯的买卖，生产能够在国际市场竞争的商品，并指出，可持续经济增长取决于国内生产、增值转化和创造就业。据他介绍，尼日利亚必须向全球销售产品，才能避免受制于世界市场。他说：“没有生产的贸易不过是买卖他人的成果。只有当我们制造产品、实现增值并在国内雇佣人员时，才会实现真正的增长。”这位部长透露，2025年非石油出口额超过$6.1 billion，同期资本流入约为$21 billion，并称这些数字证明外界对尼日利亚经济的信心正在恢复。他说，这些数据为该国巩固经济改革、加强生产部门提供了机遇。Enoh回顾称， Tinubu政府于2023年5月上任时，继承的是一个面临重大挑战的经济体，包括扭曲的外汇市场、枯竭的外汇储备、不断攀升的通货膨胀以及燃油补贴支付带来的负担。然而，他表示，政府已经启动改革，以应对结构性挑战，并推动经济重新定位，为可持续增长奠定基础。在介绍经济最新情况时，他说，截至2026年10月，尼日利亚 gross external reserves约为$55.07 billion，净储备超过$40 billion。他补充说，总体通货膨胀率已从峰值时超过34 per cent降至2026年9月的14.63 per cent，而2026年第二季度经济增长率达到4.43 per cent。部长表示，这些经济指标进一步证明，尼日利亚需要建设一个以生产为驱动、能够创造就业、增加出口并吸引可持续投资的经济体。他把这些目标与第40届拉各斯国际贸易博览会的主题“贸易、增长与全球互联”联系起来，并指出，非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）让尼日利亚得以进入一个拥有约1.4 billion人口的市场。然而，他也表示，该国必须提高产品标准、加快海关清关程序并取消不必要的贸易壁垒，才能充分利用非洲大陆市场。Enoh还提到，联邦执行委员会最近批准的《尼日利亚工业政策》是一项战略框架，旨在加强制造业、深化本地价值链，并将该国原材料转化为成品。他说，有效落实这项政策将帮助尼日利亚企业提升竞争力，并提高该国在国际贸易中的份额。拉各斯州州长Babajide Sanwo-Olu先生也在会上表示，第40届贸易博览会应为企业寻找买家、吸引投资和加强供应链提供机会。Sanwo-Olu由代表出席活动，他说，拉各斯致力于把自己打造为重要的制造业和商业中心，敦促企业增加生产、加工和增值。届时预计将有来自20多个国家的1,000多家展商参展，他说，博览会将为企业在区域和国际市场建立合作关系、探索商机提供平台。州长援引了拉各斯州在2025年Presidential Enabling Business Environment Council（PEBEC）Subnational Ease of Doing Business Report中名列第一的成绩，该州得分为85.6 per cent。他还介绍了《拉各斯州工业政策2025-2030》和拉各斯州出口准备计划，后者已支持253家中小型 enterprises为国际市场准备产品。据他介绍，该州许多微、小和中型企业拥有能够在全球竞争的产品和决心，但仍需要获得融资、技术和更大的市场，才能充分发挥潜力。他敦促参展商利用博览会的企业对企业及企业对政府平台，建立商业关系并吸引扩大经营所需的投入。拉各斯商会及工业协会（LCCI）会长工程师Leye Kupoluyi在发言中表示，过去40年来，贸易博览会在连接生产者与消费者以及促进各行业和国际边界之间的商业关系方面发挥了重要作用。Kupoluyi表示，商会正努力确保参展能够转化为实实在在的商业合作伙伴关系、业务扩张和企业实力提升。他指出，尽管经营环境充满挑战，尼日利亚企业依然展现出韧性和应变能力。然而，他强调，企业需要可靠的基础设施、可负担的融资、高效的物流、更好的安全保障和可预期的政府政策，才能扩大生产并在国内和国际市场中有效竞争。掌握第一手动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独特视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。立即在WhatsApp上加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trum.title: Trump: Lesson for Nigeria, by Stephanie Shaakaa
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trum.summary: Donald Trump wanted the November 3 midterm elections to be about him. Democrats have won control of both chambers of the United States Congress, delivering a major electoral setback to Trump and his Republican Party. There is, however, a lesson here for political leaders everywhere, including in Nigeria.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trum.summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普希望11月3日中期选举围绕他本人展开。民主党已赢得美国国会两院的控制权，对特朗普及其共和党造成重大选举挫败。然而，这一结果给包括尼日利亚在内世界各地的政治领导人都上了一课。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trum.body: Donald Trump wanted the November 3 midterm elections to be about him. He said so repeatedly, urging Americans to vote as though his name were on the ballot. He wanted a Republican victory to demonstrate that his presidency still commanded popular support and that his influence over American politics remained firmly intact. Well, Americans took him seriously. Perhaps more seriously than he expected. Democrats have won control of both chambers of the United States Congress, delivering a major electoral setback to Trump and his Republican Party. Yet, as the results became clear, Trump reached for an explanation that seemed to contradict his own campaign message. In a post on his Truth Social platform, he declared: “I wasn’t on the Ballot and if I was, we would have won IN A LANDSLIDE!” The irony is difficult to miss. He had spent weeks asking Americans to treat the election as a verdict on his presidency. When the verdict went against him, he suddenly appeared to be distancing himself from it. He wanted the political benefits of making the election about him without accepting the consequences when voters delivered an unfavourable answer. For readers in Nigeria, it is worth explaining what America calls midterm elections and why they matter. In the United States, a president is elected for a four-year term, but congressional elections take place every two years. This means that halfway into a president’s tenure, Americans return to the polls to elect members of the legislature. These elections are called midterms because they take place in the middle of a presidential term. Congress has two chambers: the House of Representatives and the Senate. All 435 seats in the House are contested every two years, while senators serve six-year terms, with approximately one-third of the 100 Senate seats contested every two years. Midterm elections do not determine who becomes president. The sitting president remains in office. Instead, voters decide which party controls Congress and, by extension, how much support or opposition the president will face in the legislature This gives Americans an opportunity to express satisfaction or dissatisfaction with a president’s performance without waiting another four years. They can strengthen the president’s party in Congress or hand control to the opposition, making it considerably more difficult for the president to advance his legislative agenda. American presidents often benefit from what is known as the coattail effect. When a president is popular, candidates from the same party can benefit from that popularity. His political strength becomes an advantage for others seeking elective office. But when a president becomes unpopular, the effect can work in reverse. Candidates associated with his administration may find themselves paying the price for public dissatisfaction with his leadership. In political terms, this is sometimes described as negative or reverse coattails. Trump’s decision to place himself at the centre of the midterm campaign made this effect particularly consequential. Instead of allowing individual Republican candidates to make their own cases to voters, he encouraged Americans to judge them through the prism of his presidency. He effectively turned hundreds of congressional contests into a national assessment of his administration. And voters had reasons to be dissatisfied. The cost of living, inflation, rising fuel prices, economic anxiety and concerns about his administration’s policies, including the war with Iran, featured prominently in the political atmosphere surrounding the election. The Associated Press’s voter analysis identified frustration over high costs and the direction of the administration among the forces behind the Republican setback. Not every voter necessarily shared the same grievance, but the cumulative dissatisfaction proved politically damaging. The scale of the Democratic victories was particularly striking in traditionally Republican territory. Texas provided one of the clearest illustrations. For decades, the state had been one of the Republican Party’s most dependable strongholds. Yet Democrat James Talarico defeated Trump-backed Ken Paxton in the Senate contest, becoming the first Democrat elected to a Texas Senate seat since 1988. In the gubernatorial race, Democrat Gina Hinojosa defeated incumbent Greg Abbott, ending Republican control of the governorship. These were not merely victories for individual candidates. They challenged the assumption that established Republican strongholds were beyond the reach of Democratic competition. One election does not permanently change a state’s political identity, but it can expose the vulnerability of a party that has grown accustomed to treating certain constituencies as guaranteed territory. The election also produced historic breakthroughs in American political representation. In Georgia, Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman elected governor of an American state. In New Hampshire, Chris Pappas became the first openly gay man elected to the United States Senate. Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed became the first Muslim elected to the Senate. Meanwhile, Hakeem Jeffries is positioned to become the first Black Speaker of the House if formally elected by the incoming Democratic majority. These achievements extend beyond party victories; they represent significant milestones in the country’s political history. But beyond the personalities and historic milestones, the institutional consequences are substantial. With Democrats controlling both chambers, Trump will face a Congress less willing to accommodate his agenda. The new majority can obstruct legislation, scrutinise government spending, investigate the administration and subject presidential appointments requiring congressional approval to greater scrutiny. Control of the Senate is particularly important because of its role in confirming federal judges and senior government officials. Trump remains president and retains his constitutional powers, including the power to veto legislation. A Democratic Congress cannot simply remove him from office or take over the executive branch. But the political environment in which he must govern has changed considerably. The final two years of his presidency will be more complicated, and his administration will have to contend with an opposition that now controls the legislative machinery. The results also raise questions about the future of the Republican Party. Trump’s endorsement has long been a powerful instrument in Republican politics. Candidates have sought his support, elected officials have adjusted their positions to accommodate his preferences, and the party has increasingly organised itself around his political identity. But when candidates associated with a president begin losing elections on a significant scale, an uncomfortable question emerges: is his influence still an electoral advantage, or has it become a liability? The answer will matter as Republicans consider their political direction beyond Trump’s second term and the road to the 2028 presidential election. None of this means that Democrats have secured a permanent realignment of American politics. Nor does it automatically determine who will win the next presidential election. Midterm results are not a crystal ball. They reflect the political mood at a particular moment, and voters can change their minds again. The Democratic Party must also demonstrate that winning control of Congress can translate into meaningful improvements in people’s lives. Defeating an unpopular administration and earning lasting public confidence are two different challenges. There is, however, a lesson here for political leaders everywhere, including in Nigeria. Elections are not always about the candidates whose names appear on the ballot. Sometimes, voters use the choices available to them to pass judgment on the person already occupying the highest office. A president may not be contesting, but his record, policies and conduct can still become the central issue in an election. Political power does not insulate an incumbent from electoral accountability, even when his name is nowhere on the ballot. Trump invited Americans to make the midterm elections a referendum on his presidency. They did. When the result went against him, he insisted that his absence from the ballot was the problem. He wanted the credit if Republicans won. He cannot so easily disown the verdict because they lost. The slingshot has turned in the opposite direction. Trump asked Americans to vote as though he were on the ballot. They did something more consequential: they voted on the presidency he was already exercising. He asked for a political endorsement and received an electoral verdict. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trum.title_zh: 特朗普：尼日利亚的教训，作者：斯蒂芬妮·沙卡
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/trum.body_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普希望11月3日的中期选举围绕他本人展开。他反复表明这一点，敦促美国人投票时仿佛选票上有他的名字。他希望共和党获胜，以证明他的总统任期仍得到民意支持，也证明他对美国政治的影响力依然稳固。嗯，美国人认真听了他的话。或许比他预想的还要认真。民主党已赢得美国国会两院的控制权，给特朗普及其共和党带来重大选举挫折。然而，随着结果逐渐明朗，特朗普却抛出一种似乎与他自己的竞选信息相矛盾的解释。他在自己的Truth Social平台上发帖宣称：“我不在选票上；如果我在，我们就会以压倒性优势获胜！”其中的讽刺意味不难看出。几周来，他一直要求美国人把这次选举视为对其总统任期的一次裁决。当裁决结果对他不利时，他突然又像是与之撇清关系。他想享受把选举变成围绕自己的政治好处，却不愿在选民给出否定答案时承担后果。对于尼日利亚的读者来说，有必要解释一下美国所称的“中期选举”以及它为何重要。在美国，总统任期为4年，但国会选举每两年举行一次。这意味着在总统任期过半时，美国人会再次前往投票站，选举立法机构成员。这些选举被称为中期选举，是因为它们在总统任期中途举行。国会设有两院：众议院和参议院。众议院全部435个席位每两年进行一次改选，而参议员任期为6年，100个参议院席位中约三分之一每两年改选一次。中期选举不决定谁出任总统。在任总统仍会继续执政。选民决定的是由哪个政党控制国会，并由此决定总统在立法机构中会面对多少支持或反对力量。这让美国人无需再等4年，便可对总统的表现表达满意或不满。他们可以加强总统所属政党在国会中的力量，也可以把控制权交给反对党，使总统推行其立法议程变得困难得多。美国总统往往会从所谓的“衣摆效应”中受益。当总统深受欢迎时，同一政党的候选人可以分享这种人气。他的政治实力会成为其他寻求公职者的优势。但当总统失去民心时，这种效应可能反向运作。与其政府有关联的候选人可能发现，公众对其领导的不满会让他们付出代价。用政治术语来说，这有时被称为负面衣摆效应或反向衣摆效应。特朗普决定把自己置于中期选举活动的中心，使这一效应产生了格外重要的后果。他没有让各个共和党候选人自行向选民陈述理由，而是鼓励美国人通过他的总统任期来评判他们。他实际上把数百场国会选举变成了对其政府的全国性检验。选民也有理由感到不满。生活成本、通货膨胀、燃油价格上涨、经济焦虑，以及对其政府各项政策的担忧，包括对伊朗的战争，均在围绕此次选举的政治氛围中占据突出位置。美联社的选民分析将高昂生活成本及政府施政方向的不满，列为共和党遭遇挫败的幕后力量。并非每名选民的不满都源于同样的原因，但累积起来的不满最终造成了政治损害。民主党在传统共和党地盘取得的胜利规模尤其引人注目。得克萨斯州提供了最清晰的例子之一。数十年来，该州一直是共和党最可靠的据点之一。然而，在参议院选举中，民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科击败了获特朗普支持的肯·帕克斯顿，成为自1988年以来首位当选得克萨斯州参议员的民主党人。在州长选举中，民主党人吉娜·希诺霍萨击败现任州长格雷格·阿博特，终结共和党对州长职位的控制。这些胜利不只是个别候选人的胜利。它们挑战了这样一种预设：共和党长期稳固的据点已经超出民主党的竞争范围。一次选举不会永久改变一个州的政治属性，但可能暴露一个已习惯把某些选区视为稳固地盘政党的脆弱之处。此次选举还在美国政治代表性方面实现了历史性突破。在佐治亚州，基沙·兰斯·博托姆斯成为首位当选美国州长的黑人女性。在新罕布什尔州，克里斯·帕帕斯成为首位当选美国参议员的公开同性恋男性。密歇根州的阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德成为首位当选参议员的穆斯林。与此同时，如果由新当选的民主党多数派正式选举，哈基姆·杰弗里斯将成为首位担任众议院议长的黑人。这些成就超越了政党胜利，构成了该国政治史上的重要里程碑。但除了人物和历史性里程碑之外，制度层面的后果同样重大。随着民主党控制两院，特朗普将面对一个更不愿配合其议程的国会。新多数派可以阻挠立法、审查政府开支、调查政府，并对需要国会批准的总统人选实施更严格的监督。参议院控制权尤其重要，因为参议院负责确认联邦法官和政府高级官员。特朗普仍是总统，并保留其宪法权力，包括否决立法的权力。民主党控制的国会不能直接将其免职，也不能接管行政部门。但他执政所处的政治环境已经发生了显著变化。他总统任期最后两年将更加复杂，其政府也将不得不应对一个如今掌控立法机器的反对派。选举结果也引出了有关共和党未来的疑问。长期以来，特朗普的背书一直是共和党政治中的有力工具。候选人争取他的支持，民选官员调整立场以迎合他的偏好，该党也日益围绕他的政治形象组织自身。但当与总统有关联的候选人大规模落败时，一个令人不安的问题便浮现出来：他的影响力仍是选举优势，还是已成为负担？当共和党考虑特朗普第二任期之后的政治方向以及通往2028年总统选举的道路时，答案将至关重要。这并不意味着民主党已经确保美国政治发生永久性的重新洗牌，也不能自动决定谁将赢得下一次总统选举。中期选举结果不是预言水晶球。它们反映某一特定时刻的政治情绪，而选民也可能再次改变主意。民主党还必须证明，拿下国会控制权能够转化为人们生活中的切实改善。击败不受欢迎的政府与赢得持久的公众信任，是两项不同的挑战。然而，这为包括尼日利亚在内的各地政治领导人提供了一个启示。选举并不总是围绕选票上出现的候选人展开。有时，选民会利用手中的选择，对已经占据最高职位的人作出评判。总统即使不参与竞选，其政绩、政策和行为仍可能成为选举的核心议题。政治权力并不能使在任者免于选举问责，即便他的名字根本没有出现在选票上。特朗普邀请美国人把中期选举变成对其总统任期的一次公投。他们照做了。当结果对他不利时，他却坚称问题出在自己不在选票上。如果共和党获胜，他希望分享功劳；但如今他们输了，他就没那么容易否认这项裁决了。弹弓已经朝相反方向反弹。特朗普要求美国人投票时仿佛他也在选票上。他们做出的举动更有后果：他们对他已经在行使的总统权力投了票。他要求得到政治背书，却收到了一项选举裁决。本文表达的观点不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何员工的意见

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.body: Justice Uwani Musa Abba Aji, yesterday, disclosed that the travel ban imposed on a seven-member panel of the Supreme Court by the United States of America (USA) was occasioned by a misinterpretation of a judgement delivered by members of the panel. Justice Abba Aji, made the disclosure at a special valedictory court session held in her honour at the Supreme Court in Abuja. Abba Aji who was the first female judge from Yobe State and second female Justice from the North-east geopolitical zone, bows out from the judiciary on today (November 7), upon attaining the mandatory 70 years retirement age. The newly retired justice who stated that the ban is still on till date lamented that the ban was part of inconveniences and a small price to pay by judicial officers to preserve the chastity of justice. Recalling her experience while on the bench, she said, “My time on the Supreme Court bench was filled with challenges, some of which have served as additional opportunities to stand firm on the side of justice, regardless of the consequences. She also recalled the year 2016 while on a programme at Washington DC in the USA, she received a call that her attention was needed by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) over a petition against her in Lagos. She explained that the petition made her a regular visitor at the EFCC office answering questions on allegations of corruption she knew nothing about adding that, at the end of the investigations, she was exonerated from all the allegations. Despite the exoneration, she said that the situation was chaotic and made a very difficult time for her as slanders had filled the air, adding that to worsen the situation, she could not speak in her own defense in public because of the conservative nature of the judiciary. The retiring apex court justice, charged the younger generation of judges to hold fast to integrity and let justice be their compass. Specifically, she counselled serving judges to serve with humility and courage and to always remember that the law is not merely a profession but a trust. Earlier, the Chief Justice of Nigeria (CJN), Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun, who presided over the special court session congratulated Justice Abba Aji for diligent service to the country’s judiciary and for leaving the Supreme Court bench with an unblemished record of service. The CJN said that the career of Justice Abba Aji in the judiciary and the legal profession was so important to the nation and women who have followed her example on the Bench. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.body_zh: 司法大法官乌瓦尼·穆萨·阿巴·阿吉昨天透露，美国对最高法院一个由7名成员组成的小组实施的旅行禁令，是因为误解了该小组成员作出的判决。阿巴·阿吉大法官是在阿布贾最高法院举行的、专门为她举行的荣休庭审会上披露这一消息的。阿巴·阿吉是来自约贝州的首位女性法官，也是尼日利亚东北地缘政治区域的第二名女性大法官。她在达到强制规定的70岁退休年龄后，于今天（11月7日）正式结束司法生涯。这名刚刚退休的大法官表示，该禁令至今仍然有效；她感叹说，这项禁令是司法人员为维护司法纯洁性而承受的诸多不便之一，也是必须付出的微小代价。回顾自己担任法官期间的经历，她说：“我在最高法院法官席上的日子充满挑战，其中一些挑战反而给了我更多机会，让我不计后果地坚持站在正义一边。”她还回忆说，2016年她在美国的华盛顿特区参加一个项目期间，接到经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的电话，要求她前往拉各斯回应针对她的申诉。她解释说，这项申诉使她经常到经济和金融犯罪委员会办公室回答有关腐败指控的问题，而她对这些指控一无所知；她补充说，调查结束后，所有针对她的指控均被排除。尽管获得了平反，她仍表示当时的局面十分混乱，给她带来了非常艰难的处境，因为诽谤之声四处传播；更糟的是，由于司法系统较为保守，她无法在公开场合为自己辩护。这名即将退休的最高法院大法官告诫年轻一代法官，要坚守诚信，让正义成为自己的指路明灯。具体而言，她劝勉在职法官要以谦逊和勇气履职，并始终牢记，法律不仅是一项职业，更是一种责任。此前，主持特别庭审的尼日利亚首席大法官（CJN）库迪拉特·凯克雷-埃库恩大法官，祝贺阿巴·阿吉大法官为尼日利亚司法系统作出的辛勤贡献，并肯定她以毫无污点的履职记录离开最高法院法官席。首席大法官表示，阿巴·阿吉大法官在司法系统和法律界的职业生涯，对国家和那些以她为榜样走上法官席的女性而言都具有重要意义。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办事处。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层报道，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供汇聚新思想、文化与技术的交汇平台。该报是一项公共信托，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面
